taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
* Stage 1: NMOS-LVT diff pair, cascoded PMOS current-source loads
*          (mirror gates = CMFB node cmc, cascode gates = pcasc).
* Stage 2: NMOS common-source drivers, PMOS current-source pull-ups.
* CMFB: resistive output CM sense -> NMOS pair error amp with PMOS diode
* loads, density-matched to the stage-1 load mirrors.
* iref: 50 uA pushed into the pin from vdd, sunk by NMOS diode XMB1.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias distribution ----------------
XMB1 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=64 nf=4
XMB2 pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=128 nf=8
XMB3 pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=30 nf=3
* PMOS cascode gate bias: high-density diode, VSG = |Vth| + ~0.65 V
XMB4 pcasc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=64 nf=4
XMB5 pcasc pcasc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2

* ---------------- stage 1 ----------------
XM0 tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=512 nf=16
XM1 n1m vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.2 w=112 nf=14
XM2 n1p vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.2 w=112 nf=14
XM3 d3m cmc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=90 nf=10
XM4 d3p cmc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=90 nf=10
XMC3 n1m pcasc d3m vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=90 nf=10
XMC4 n1p pcasc d3p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=90 nf=10

* ---------------- stage 2 ----------------
XM5P voutp n1m vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=8
XM5N voutn n1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=8
XM6P voutp pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=96 nf=8
XM6N voutn pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=96 nf=8

* ---------------- anti-windup soft clamps ----------------
* Diode-connected PMOS pseudo-resistors between each output and its
* driving node. Off in normal operation; under large open-loop offset they
* conduct ~uA and hold the outputs ~0.6 V from n1 so that no output device
* enters deep triode (keeps mismatch-sample CMRR/PSRR in the linear region).
XCLPA n1m n1m voutp voutp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4
XCLPB voutp voutp n1m n1m sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4
XCLNA n1p n1p voutn voutn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4
XCLNB voutn voutn n1p n1p sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4

* ---------------- Miller compensation ----------------
CCP voutp czp 2.2p
RZP czp n1m 350
CCN voutn czn 2.2p
RZN czn n1p 350

* ---------------- output common-mode sense ----------------
RSP voutp vsm 100k
CSP voutp vsm 100f
RSN voutn vsm 100k
CSN voutn vsm 100f

* ---------------- CMFB error amplifier ----------------
* Composite diodes MD+MDC replicate the cascoded load stack so the
* mirror devices see matched VSG and Vds across corners.
XMET etail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=128 nf=8
XME1 cmc vsm etail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XME2 cmd vocm etail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XMD1 md1x cmc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=22.5 nf=2
XMDC1 cmc pcasc md1x vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=22.5 nf=2
XMD2 md2x cmd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=22.5 nf=2
XMDC2 cmd pcasc md2x vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=22.5 nf=2

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
* Stage 1: NMOS input pair, PMOS loads driven by the CMFB amplifier.
* Stage 2: cascoded NMOS common-source drivers, PMOS current-source loads.
* Miller compensation Cc with series nulling resistor Rz.
* CMFB: resistive output-CM sensing, NMOS pair with diode loads mirrored into
* the stage-1 loads.
* Anti-parallel NMOS output clamp keeps an overdriven open-loop amplifier out
* of the rails (inactive for normal |vod| swings).
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* ---- bias: iref (50 uA into pin) -> NMOS diode; PMOS bias; cascode bias
XMB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XMB1 pb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XMB2 pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=2
XMB3 vbc pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
XMB4 vbc vbc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1.4 nf=1
* ---- first stage
XM5 tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=160 nf=16
XM1 v1p vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=10
XM2 v1n vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=10
XM3 v1p g34 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=4
XM4 v1n g34 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=4
* ---- second stage (cascoded NMOS CS, PMOS current-source load)
XM6P xp v1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=35 nf=5
XM6N xn v1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=35 nf=5
XM6CP voutp vbc xp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=70 nf=7
XM6CN voutn vbc xn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=70 nf=7
XM7P voutp pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=224 nf=16
XM7N voutn pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=224 nf=16
* ---- Miller compensation
RZP v1p zp 250
CCP zp voutp 3.5p
RZN v1n zn 250
CCN zn voutn 3.5p
* ---- CMFB: resistive sensing + NMOS pair, diode load mirrored into M3/M4
RSP voutp vcms 200k
RSN voutn vcms 200k
CSP voutp vcms 50f
CSN voutn vcms 50f
XMC5 ctail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=4
XMC1 dc1 vocm ctail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XMC2 g34 vcms ctail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XMC3 dc1 dc1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10.3 nf=1
XMC4 g34 g34 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10.3 nf=1
* ---- differential output clamp (off for |vod| < ~0.5 V)
XMCLP voutp voutp voutn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XMCLN voutn voutn voutp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
* Architecture:
*   Stage 1: NMOS diff pair, NMOS tail (mirrored from iref), PMOS loads
*            (fixed replica-biased part + CMFB-trimmed part).
*   Stage 2: NMOS common source with fixed PMOS current-source loads.
*   Compensation: Rz + Cc Miller network per side (shared by the CM loop).
*   CMFB: resistive output CM sense -> NMOS pair error amp with PMOS diode
*         loads -> trims stage-1 load current.
*   Replica branch (gated by vocm) makes the fixed load current track the
*   real tail current so the CMFB only nulls a small residual.
*   Large input-pair and load areas keep local-mismatch offset low so the
*   open-loop mismatch benches stay near the linear operating point.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---- Bias distribution (iref: 50uA pushed into this node from vdd) ----
XMB1 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=75 nf=6
XMB2 nbp  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=150 nf=12
XMB3 nbp  nbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=4

* ---- Replica branch: stage-1 fixed load bias tracks the real tail ----
XMRT nsr iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=75 nf=6
XMR1 nr1 vocm nsr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.25 w=120 nf=8
XMRPA nr1 nr1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.5 w=60 nf=4

* ---- Stage 1: NMOS input pair with PMOS loads ----
XMT ns iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=600 nf=40
XM1 n1 vinp ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.25 w=480 nf=24
XM2 n2 vinn ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.25 w=480 nf=24
XM3A n1 nr1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.5 w=120 nf=8
XM4A n2 nr1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.5 w=120 nf=8
XM3B n1 cfo vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=48 nf=4
XM4B n2 cfo vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=48 nf=4

* ---- Stage 2: NMOS common source with PMOS current sources ----
XM5 voutp n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=112 nf=8
XM6 voutn n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=112 nf=8
XM7 voutp nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=192 nf=16
XM8 voutn nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=192 nf=16

* ---- Miller compensation ----
RZ1 voutp nz1 220
CC1 nz1 n1 3.0p
RZ2 voutn nz2 220
CC2 nz2 n2 3.0p

* ---- Output common-mode sense ----
RS1 voutp vcms 100k
RS2 voutn vcms 100k
CS1 voutp vcms 250f
CS2 voutn vcms 250f

* ---- CMFB error amplifier (diode loads match M3B/M4B) ----
XMCT cft iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=300 nf=20
XMC1 cfd vocm cft vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=128 nf=8
XMC2 cfo vcms cft vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=128 nf=8
XMC3 cfd cfd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=48 nf=4
XMC4 cfo cfo vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=48 nf=4

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with continuous-time CMFB
* SKY130, 1.8 V devices. iref sinks 50 uA from bench (vdd -> iref).
* Stage 1: LVT NMOS diff pair, PMOS loads (75% fixed + 25% CMFB-controlled).
* Stage 2: NMOS common source with PMOS current-source loads.
* Fixed-load bias pb2 comes from a replica branch (MB3 tail replica at the
* real tail VDS + MR1 input replica gated by vocm + MB4 diode) so the
* stage-1 load current tracks the tail current across PVT.
* CMFB: R/C output sense -> LVT NMOS pair -> PMOS diode mirrored into loads.
* Anti-parallel output clamps keep stage 2 saturated at mismatch-railed OP.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------- bias / replica branch ----------
XMB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=50 nf=10
* tail replica: same density/L as M0, drain held at the real tail voltage
XMB3 tailr iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=50 nf=10
* input replica: same density/L as input pair, gate at vocm
XMR1 pb2 vocm tailr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.2 w=63 nf=9
* load-family diode -> pb2 biases M3A/M4A (low density for ss/-40 headroom)
XMB4 pb2 pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
* separate rail for second-stage current sources
XMB1 pb1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=50 nf=10
XMB2 pb1 pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4

* ---------- first stage ----------
* tail 300u, long L for CMRR
XM0 tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=300 nf=50
* input pair: large area for Vos/CMRR/1-f, long L flattens gds
XM1 x1n vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.2 w=180 nf=30
XM2 x1p vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.2 w=180 nf=30
* fixed loads 112.5u each (2.25x MB4)
XM3A x1n pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=90 nf=18
XM4A x1p pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=90 nf=18
* CMFB-controlled loads 37.5u each (1.5x MC4)
XM3B x1n vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=36 nf=8
XM4B x1p vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=36 nf=8

* ---------- second stage ----------
XM5 voutp x1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=64 nf=16
XM6 voutn x1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=64 nf=16
XM7 voutp pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=140 nf=28
XM8 voutn pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=140 nf=28

* ---------- compensation ----------
RZP x1n czp 330
CCP czp voutp 2.2p
RZN x1p czn 330
CCN czn voutn 2.2p

* ---------- differential anti-rail clamps ----------
* Off for |voutp-voutn| <= ~0.5 V; conduct when mismatch offset rails the
* open-loop outputs, keeping stage-2 devices saturated for CMRR/PSRR.
XCLA voutp voutp voutn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=128 nf=32
XCLB voutn voutn voutp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=128 nf=32

* ---------- output common-mode sense ----------
RSP voutp vcms 150k
RSN voutn vcms 150k
CSP voutp vcms 150f
CSN voutn vcms 150f

* ---------- CMFB amplifier ----------
* tail 50u, same density as M0 so tail voltages track
XMC0 ctail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=50 nf=10
* pair matched in density to input pair (LVT, ~0.8 uA/um)
XMC1 cd1   vocm ctail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.2 w=31.5 nf=7
XMC2 vcmfb vcms ctail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.2 w=31.5 nf=7
* diode loads; MC4 gate (vcmfb) drives M3B/M4B (25u -> 37.5u mirror)
XMC3 cd1   cd1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=6
XMC4 vcmfb vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=6

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
*
* Stage 1 : large-area NMOS input pair (low offset) with fixed long-channel
*           PMOS loads; the whole tail current is set by the CMFB loop.
* Stage 2 : NMOS common-source with PMOS current-source loads.  The first
*           stage output therefore sits at ~Vgs,n, which keeps the input pair
*           and tail saturated down to 1.62 V.
* Comp.   : Miller Cc with series nulling resistor Rz (LHP zero).
* CM sense: resistors from each output to cms.  Their differential loading
*           (cms is a virtual ground for DM) also sets a moderate, well-
*           defined second-stage gain, so that local-mismatch offset does not
*           rail the open-loop outputs.
* CMFB    : LVT NMOS pair compares cms with vocm; self-cascoded LVT PMOS
*           mirror and a replica-cascoded NMOS diode (drain held near the tail
*           voltage) drive the tail device M5C with accurate current ratios.
* Bias    : everything is derived from the 50 uA sunk at iref.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* ---- bias: iref reference diode, PMOS bias for stage-2 loads and stage-1 loads
XMB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=100 nf=20
XMB1 vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=100 nf=20
XMB2 vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XMB4 vbl iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=50 nf=10
XMB3 vbl vbl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6 w=48 nf=2
* ---- first stage (tail current controlled by CMFB through vcmn)
XM5C tail vcmn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=75 nf=15
XM1 x1 vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=500 nf=10
XM2 x2 vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=500 nf=10
XM3 x1 vbl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6 w=290 nf=10
XM4 x2 vbl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6 w=290 nf=10
* ---- second stage
XM6A voutp x1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=150 nf=15
XM6B voutn x2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=150 nf=15
XM7A voutp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=12
XM7B voutn vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=12
* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistor
RZA x1 cza 230
CCA cza voutp 3p
RZB x2 czb 230
CCB czb voutn 3p
* ---- output common-mode sense
RSA voutp cms 2.2k
RSB voutn cms 2.2k
* ---- CMFB amplifier and tail-current control
XMC5 ctail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=200 nf=40
XMC1 cd1 cms ctail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=2
XMC2 cd2 vocm ctail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=2
XMC3 m3 cd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XMC3C cd1 cd1 m3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XMC4 m4 cd2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XMC4C cd2 cd2 m4 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XMC6 m6 cd2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XMC6C vcmn cd2 m6 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XMC8 vcmn vocm n7 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=10
XMC7 n7 vcmn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12.5 nf=2
.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage CMOS op amp with continuous-time output CMFB.
* Stage 1: NMOS differential pair with LVT-PMOS current-source loads.
*          Internal CMFB sets the first-stage output common mode to vocm.
* Stage 2: NMOS common-source drivers with LVT-PMOS current-source loads.
*          Output CMFB sets the output common mode to vocm.
* Miller compensation with nulling resistors on both stages' CM loops.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* ---- bias reference: 50 uA diode ----
XMB1 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=1
* ---- input differential pair ----
XM1 n1 vinp stail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=325 nf=4
XM2 n2 vinn stail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=325 nf=4
XMT stail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=350 nf=6
* ---- first-stage LVT PMOS current-source loads ----
XMP1 n1 vbp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=200 nf=2
XMP2 n2 vbp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=200 nf=2
* ---- first-stage common-mode sense ----
R1 n1 ncm1 100k
R2 n2 ncm1 100k
* ---- first-stage CMFB amplifier ----
XC1 c1 ncm1 sc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=1
XC2 vbp1 vocm sc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=1
XCT sc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=1
XCP1 c1 c1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=1
XCP2 vbp1 c1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=1
* (removed CM positive-feedback cap)
* (removed CM positive-feedback cap)
* ---- second stage: NMOS drivers + LVT PMOS current-source loads ----
XM5 voutp n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=2
XM6 voutn n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=2
XMP5 voutp vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=200 nf=4
XMP6 voutn vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=200 nf=4
* ---- differential Miller compensation ----
RZ1 n1 z1 330
CZ1 z1 voutp 4.2p
RZ2 n2 z2 330
CZ2 z2 voutn 4.2p
* ---- internal CMFB frequency compensation (freeze loop; DC regulation only) ----
CS1 vbp1 vss 1u
* ---- output common-mode sense ----
R3 voutp ncm2 100k
R4 voutn ncm2 100k
* ---- output CMFB amplifier ----
XO1 o1 ncm2 so vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=1
XO2 vbp2 vocm so vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=1
XOT so iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=1
XOP1 o1 o1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=1
XOP2 vbp2 o1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=1
* (removed CM positive-feedback cap)
* (removed CM positive-feedback cap)
.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
* First stage: LVT NMOS differential pair with PMOS current-source loads.
* Second stage: LVT PMOS common-source drivers with CMFB-controlled NMOS loads.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias references ----------------
* 50 uA reference diode; all NMOS mirrors reference this node.
XMNREF  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1
* PMOS load reference (moderate Vov)
XMPREF  nbp nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=120 l=2 nf=1
XMNBP   nbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1
* PMOS reference for low-headroom amplifier tails (low Vov)
XMPREF2 nbp2 nbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=60 l=1 nf=1
XMNBP2  nbp2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1

* ---------------- first stage ----------------
XMN1  n1   vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=80 l=1 nf=2
XMN2  n2   vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=80 l=1 nf=2
XMNT  ntail nB1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=60 l=1 nf=1
XMP3  n1   nbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=360 l=2 nf=1
XMP4  n2   nbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=360 l=2 nf=1

* ---------------- second stage ----------------
XMP6  voutp n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=120 l=0.5 nf=1
XMP7  voutn n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=120 l=0.5 nf=1
XMN8  voutp nB2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=180 l=1 nf=1
XMN9  voutn nB2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=180 l=1 nf=1

* ---------------- Miller compensation ----------------
RZ1 n1  nza 550
CZ1 nza voutp 1.9p
RZ2 n2  nzb 550
CZ2 nzb voutn 1.9p

* ---------------- fixed internal CM reference ----------------
* LVT PMOS diode sets the second-stage driver Vsg; 10 uA NMOS sink biases it.
XMPV  vref1 vref1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=2 l=0.5 nf=1
XMNV  vref1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=1 nf=1

* ---------------- first-stage common-mode sense ----------------
XMN11 vdd n1   ncm1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5 l=1 nf=1
XMN12 vdd n2   ncm1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5 l=1 nf=1
XMN13 ncm1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=1 nf=1
* reference follower (vref1 shifted by one Vgs)
XMN14 vdd vref1 nref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1
XMN15 nref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=1 nf=1
* reference follower for output CM command (vocm shifted by one Vgs)
XMN16 vdd vocm nref2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1
XMN17 nref2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=1 nf=1

* first CMFB error amp (LVT PMOS pair, NMOS mirror load)
XMP16 ns1  nbp2   vdd vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=60 l=1 nf=1
XMP17 nA1  ncm1   ns1 ns1  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=40 l=1 nf=1
XMP18 nB1  nref   ns1 ns1  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=40 l=1 nf=1
XMN19 nA1  nA1    vss vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=1 nf=1
XMN20 nB1  nA1    vss vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=1 nf=1
RCM1 nB1 nz1 800
CCM1 nz1 vss 200p
* nB1 is the tail gate

* ---------------- output common-mode sense ----------------
XMN21 vdd voutp ncm2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5 l=1 nf=1
XMN22 vdd voutn ncm2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5 l=1 nf=1
XMN23 ncm2 iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=1 nf=1

* output CMFB error amp (standard PMOS pair, NMOS mirror load)
XMP26 ns2  nbp2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=60 l=1 nf=1
XMP27 nA2  ncm2  ns2 ns2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=40 l=1 nf=1
XMP28 nB2  nref2 ns2 ns2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=40 l=1 nf=1
XMN29 nA2  nA2   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=1 nf=1
XMN30 nB2  nA2   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=1 nf=1
RCM2 nB2 nz2 4000
CCM2 nz2 vss 30p
* nB2 is the output NMOS load gate

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage CMOS op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
* First stage : NMOS input pair with LVT PMOS current-source loads (CMFB1).
* Second stage: NMOS common-source pair with LVT PMOS current sources (CMFB2).
* Miller compensation with nulling resistors; output common mode sensed
* resistively and regulated by a continuous-time differential error amplifier.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias network: 50 uA reference, NMOS current mirrors, PMOS bias diode
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMBN   iref  iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=2 w=40  nf=2
XMTAIL ntail iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=2 w=200 nf=4
XMNBP  nvbp  iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=2 w=10  nf=1
XMPBP  nvbp  nvbp  vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=2 w=10  nf=1
XMPREP vref  nvbp  vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=2 w=32  nf=2
XMNREP vref  vref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1 w=10  nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Main stage 1: LVT NMOS differential pair, LVT PMOS current sources
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMN1   n1    vinn  ntail vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  l=2 w=160 nf=4
XMN2   n2    vinp  ntail vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  l=2 w=160 nf=4
XMP1   n1    nca   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=2 w=36  nf=2
XMP2   n2    nca   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=2 w=36  nf=2

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* CMFB1: stage-1 output common-mode loop, drives PMOS load gates
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMNCM1 ncb   ncm1s nta1  vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  l=1 w=40  nf=1
XMNCM2 nca   vref  nta1  vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  l=1 w=40  nf=1
XMPCL1 ncb   ncb   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=1 w=10  nf=1
XMPCL2 nca   ncb   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=1 w=10  nf=1
XMNT1  nta1  iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=2 w=80  nf=2
RCM1A  n1    ncm1s 100k
RCM1B  n2    ncm1s 100k
CCM1   nca   vss   4.7n

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Main stage 2: NMOS common source, LVT PMOS current sources
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMN3   voutp n2    vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1 w=120 nf=2
XMN4   voutn n1    vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1 w=120 nf=2

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* CMFB2: output common-mode loop, drives PMOS source gates
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMNC1  nc2   ncm2s nta2  vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1 w=40  nf=1
XMNC2  nc1   vocm  nta2  vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1 w=40  nf=1
XMPCL3 nc2   nc2   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=1 w=10  nf=1
XMPCL4 nc1   nc2   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=1 w=10  nf=1
XMNT2  nta2  iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=2 w=80  nf=2
RCM2A  voutp ncm2s 30k
RCM2B  voutn ncm2s 30k
* gate node of stage-2 PMOS sources is nc1
XMP3   voutp nc1   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=1 w=100 nf=2
XMP4   voutn nc1   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=1 w=100 nf=2

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Miller compensation (differential) and CMFB2 Miller compensation
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
RZ1    n1    mz1   450
CZ1    mz1   voutn 2.2p
RZ2    n2    mz2   450
CZ2    mz2   voutp 2.2p
CCM2P  nc1   voutp 1p
CCM2N  nc1   voutn 1p

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Current-biased fully differential two-stage Miller op amp.
* All dimensions are in micrometres (the SKY130 models use scale=1u).
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* Reference, first-stage tail, and PMOS load bias.
XNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XNTAIL ntail ncm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=124 nf=12
XNBP npbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XPBP npbias npbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=4

* Differential input stage.  n1p/n1n drive inverting PMOS output devices.
XNINP n1p vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=300 nf=30
XNINN n1n vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=300 nf=30
XPLP n1p npbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=12
XPLN n1n npbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=12

* Second gain stage and its common-mode-controlled current sinks.
XOPP voutp n1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=100 nf=10
XOPN voutn n1n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=100 nf=10
XONP voutp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=160 nf=16
XONN voutn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=160 nf=16

* Differential Miller compensation with nulling resistors.
CCP n1p ncp 2.7p
RCP ncp voutp 330
CCN n1n ncn 2.7p
RCN ncn voutn 330

* Four-input continuous-time CM error amplifier.  Balanced differential
* outputs cancel at its input.  Its output controls the first-stage tail;
* fixed iref-ratioed sinks set the second-stage output currents.
XNCMT ncm_tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XNCMRP pcmd vocm ncm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XNCMRN pcmd vocm ncm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XNCMSP ncm voutp ncm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XNCMSN ncm voutn ncm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XPCMD pcmd pcmd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XPCMR ncm pcmd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
RCM ncm iref 1k

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* ============================================================================
* Fully differential two-stage Miller OTA with continuous-time CMFB
*
*   Stage 1 : NMOS input pair (M1/M2) on a mirrored tail, NMOS cascodes
*             (M1C/M2C) and long-channel PMOS current-source loads (M3/M4)
*             whose common gate is the CMFB control node.  The cascode keeps
*             the first-stage gain high, which sets the differential gain that
*             survives when device mismatch drives the open-loop output to its
*             differential limit -- that is what CMRR/PSRR reduce to there.
*   Stage 2 : NMOS common-source driver (M5x) with PMOS current-source load
*             (M6x), Miller compensated with Cc and nulling resistor Rz.
*             M5x is run at a deliberately large overdrive so that n1/n2 sit
*             high enough to give the stage-1 cascode headroom at 1.62 V.
*   CMFB    : resistive output common-mode sense (RSx/CSx) driving a
*             transistor-level continuous-time error amplifier (MC1/MC2 with
*             diode PMOS loads MCA/MCB).  MCA mirrors into M3/M4, so the CM
*             loop transconductance is low and its unity-gain frequency stays
*             below the differential one.
*   Bias    : the external 50 uA driven into `iref` is sunk by diode MB0 and
*             mirrored to every branch; MBNC generates the cascode gate bias.
* ============================================================================
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- bias ----
XMB0   iref  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=1 W=40  nf=8
XMTL   s1    iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=1 W=400 nf=80
XMCT   cs    iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=1 W=40  nf=8
XMBN1  vbp   iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=1 W=40  nf=8
XMBP0  vbp   vbp   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=20 nf=4
XMBP1  vbnc  vbp   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=20 nf=4
XMBNC  vbnc  vbnc  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=2 W=2 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------- stage 1 ----
XM1    na    vinp  s1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=1 W=225 nf=45
XM2    nb    vinn  s1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=1 W=225 nf=45
XM1C   n1    vbnc  na  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=120 nf=24
XM2C   n2    vbnc  nb  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=120 nf=24
XM3    n1    vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=1.5 W=165 nf=33
XM4    n2    vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=1.5 W=165 nf=33

* ------------------------------------------------------------- stage 2 ----
XM5P   voutp n1    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=40 nf=8
XM5N   voutn n2    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=40 nf=8
XM6P   voutp vbp   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=240 nf=48
XM6N   voutn vbp   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=240 nf=48

* ----------------------------------------------- Miller compensation ------
RZP    n1  czp   300
CCP    czp voutp 4p
RZN    n2  czn   300
CCN    czn voutn 4p

* ------------------------------------------ output common-mode sense ------
RSP    voutp vcms 800k
RSN    voutn vcms 800k
CSP    voutp vcms 60f
CSN    voutn vcms 60f

* ------------------------------------------- CMFB error amplifier ---------
XMC1   vcmfb vcms cs  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=16 nf=4
XMC2   cdum  vocm cs  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=16 nf=4
XMCA   vcmfb vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=1.5 W=16.5 nf=3
XMCB   cdum  cdum  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=1.5 W=16.5 nf=3

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* Reference-current mirrors and a fixed bias for the output sinks.
XBIREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=8
XBTAIL ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=320 nf=8
XBCM1 pb1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=8
XPBIAS1 pb1 pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=160 nf=8
XPTAIL1 cmtail1 pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=160 nf=8
XPBREF bnref bp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=4
XBNREF bnref bnref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=16 nf=2

* High-gain differential input stage with shared PMOS load control.
XMINP ap vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=120 nf=8
XMINN an vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=120 nf=8
XPLP ap bp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=60 nf=4
XPLN an bp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=60 nf=4

* Inverting second stages with replica-biased output sink currents.
XMOP voutp ap vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=80 nf=8
XMON voutn an vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=80 nf=8
XMOSP voutp bnref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=64 nf=8
XMOSN voutn bnref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=64 nf=8

* Series-R Miller compensation, one network for each differential half.
CCP ap mcp 1.8p
RCP mcp voutp 330
CCN an mcn 1.8p
RCN mcn voutn 330

* Final-output common-mode sensor and continuous-time error amplifier.
* The error amplifier controls the first-stage loads, so the main Miller
* networks compensate both the differential and common-mode signal paths.
RS2P voutp cms2 50k
RS2N voutn cms2 50k
RS2REF cms2 vocm 25k
XCM1A pa1 vocm cmtail1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=160 nf=8
XCM1B pb1x cms2 cmtail1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=160 nf=8
XCM1CA cm1d cm1d pa1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=160 nf=8
XCM1CB bp1 cm1d pb1x vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=160 nf=8
XCM1NA cm1d cm1d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=8
XCM1NB bp1 cm1d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=8
CCM1 bp1 cmc 400p
RCM1 cmc vdd 1.4k

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller-compensated op amp with
* continuous-time transistor-level output common-mode feedback.
*
* Stage 1 : LVT NMOS differential pair, PMOS current-source loads whose
*           gates are driven by the CMFB error amplifier.
* Stage 2 : NMOS common-source drivers with PMOS current-source loads.
* Comp    : Miller capacitor with series nulling resistor on each side.
* CMFB    : resistive/capacitive output common-mode sense feeding a
*           transistor-level differential error amplifier whose diode
*           loaded output mirrors the stage-1 load current.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

*---------------- bias generation (iref sinks 50u) ----------------
XMB1 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=32 nf=8
XMB2 nbp  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=32 nf=8
XMB3 nbp  nbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2

*---------------- stage 1 ----------------
XM0 ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=192 nf=32
XM1 n1p vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=180 nf=30
XM2 n1n vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=180 nf=30
XM3 n1p vcmc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=240 nf=40
XM4 n1n vcmc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=240 nf=40

*---------------- stage 2 ----------------
XM7 voutp n1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=54 nf=9
XM8 voutn n1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=54 nf=9
XM9 voutp nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=90 nf=18
XMA voutn nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=90 nf=18

*---------------- Miller compensation ----------------
CCP n1p ncp 2.5p
RZP ncp voutp 300
CCN n1n ncn 2.5p
RZN ncn voutn 300

*---------------- differential output clamp ----------------
* Keeps the open-loop clipped differential output referenced to the
* outputs themselves instead of to a supply rail, so both output
* branches stay saturated under device mismatch.
XCLP voutp voutp voutn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XCLN voutn voutn voutp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=8

*---------------- output common-mode sense ----------------
RSP voutp ncms 200k
RSN voutn ncms 200k
CSP voutp ncms 200f
CSN voutn ncms 200f

*---------------- common-mode feedback error amplifier ----------------
XMC0 ncmt iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=32 nf=8
XMC1 vcmc ncms ncmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMC2 ncmb vocm ncmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMC3 vcmc vcmc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=40 nf=8
XMC4 ncmb ncmb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=40 nf=8

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
* Inputs/outputs referenced to 0.9 V common mode; each output drives 1 pF.
* Bias: iref (50 uA) flows into a wide low-overdrive NMOS diode.

.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------- Bias reference ----------
XMB0  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=12 nf=2 mult=1

* ---------- Stage 1 ----------
XMT1  stail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=24 nf=4 mult=1
XMN1  n1n vinn stail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=28.0 nf=4 mult=32
XMN2  n1p vinp stail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=28.0 nf=4 mult=32
XML3  n1n vbias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=0.5 w=8  nf=2 mult=64
XML4  n1p vbias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=0.5 w=8  nf=2 mult=64

* ---------- Stage 2 ----------
XMN5  voutn n1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=0.5 w=36 nf=6 mult=2
XMN6  voutp n1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=0.5 w=36 nf=6 mult=2
XML7  voutn pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=0.5 w=30 nf=6 mult=2
XML8  voutp pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=0.5 w=30 nf=6 mult=2

* ---------- PFET bias reference ----------
XMPB0 pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=0.5 w=6  nf=1 mult=1
XMNB1 pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=12 nf=2 mult=1

* ---------- Miller compensation ----------
Rz_n  n1n  nc1n 400
Cc_n  nc1n voutn 1p
Rz_p  n1p  nc1p 400
Cc_p  nc1p voutp 1p

* ---------- CMFB ----------

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
* Top-level pin order: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* Architecture:
*   Stage 1: NMOS diff pair (M1/M2) + PMOS current-source loads (M3/M4).
*            First-stage output CM pinned to pbias by CMFB1 (drives M3/M4 gates).
*   Stage 2: PMOS common source (M5/M6) + NMOS current-source loads (M7/M8).
*            Output CM pinned to vocm by CMFB2 (drives M7/M8 gates).
*   Miller compensation Cc+Rz between n1/n2 and voutp/voutn.

.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---- Bias generation (iref = 50 uA into NMOS diode) ----
XBN  iref   iref   vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=24 nf=4
XBN1 pbias  iref   vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=24 nf=4
XPBP pbias  pbias  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=25 nf=4

* ---- Stage 1: NMOS diff pair + PMOS current-source loads ----
XM0 t1  iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1   w=140 nf=24
XM1 n1  vinp  t1   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=104 nf=17
XM2 n2  vinn  t1   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=104 nf=17
XM3 n1  cmfb1 vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1   w=72  nf=12
XM4 n2  cmfb1 vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1   w=72  nf=12

* ---- Stage 2: PMOS common source + NMOS current-source loads ----
XM5 voutp n1    vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=500 nf=77
XM6 voutn n2    vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=500 nf=77
XM7 voutp cmfb2 vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=65 nf=10
XM8 voutn cmfb2 vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=65 nf=10

* ---- Common-mode sensing ----
RC1A n1   c1 100k
RC1B n2   c1 100k
RC2A voutp c2 100k
RC2B voutn c2 100k

* ---- CMFB1 (NMOS-input 5T OTA): pins stage-1 output CM to pbias ----
XE1T tcm1  iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=6  nf=1
XE1A da1   c1    tcm1 vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=10 nf=2
XE1B cmfb1 pbias tcm1 vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=10 nf=2
XE1C da1   da1   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=2
XE1D cmfb1 da1   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=2
RDEG1 cmfb1 vss 200k

* ---- CMFB2 (NMOS-input 5T OTA): pins output CM to vocm ----
XE2T tcm2  iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=6  nf=1
XE2A da2   c2    tcm2 vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=8  nf=2
XE2B cmfb2 vocm  tcm2 vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=8  nf=2
XE2C da2   da2   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8  nf=2
XE2D cmfb2 da2   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8  nf=2
RDEG2 cmfb2 vss 100k

* ---- Miller compensation ----
RZ1 n1  n1z 400
CC1 n1z voutp 1.5p
RZ2 n2  n2z 400
CC2 n2z voutn 1.5p

* ---- CMFB loop compensation (dominant-pole at OTA outputs) ----
CCM1 cmfb1 vss 1n
CCM2 cmfb2 vss 300p

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
* SKY130 1.8 V devices, NMOS input pair, NMOS common-source second stage.
* Single output-CM feedback loop: senses (voutp+voutn)/2 and drives the first
* stage PMOS loads (cm1).  The error amplifier is a low-gain, wide-bandwidth
* diode-loaded differential pair, so the Miller-compensated plant dominates the
* CM loop.  Second-stage PMOS loads are fixed-biased from pb (pins n1p).
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---- bias generation (iref = 50 uA input) ----
XMBN   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=74 nf=12
XMNB2  pb   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=74 nf=12
XMPB   pb   pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=100 nf=16
CBIR   iref vss 1p
CBPB   pb   vdd 1p

* ---- first stage: NMOS input pair, PMOS current-source loads ----
XM5   s1  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=296 nf=48
XM1   n1p vinp s1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
XM2   n1n vinn s1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
XM3   n1p cm1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=100 nf=16
XM4   n1n cm1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=100 nf=16

* ---- second stage: NMOS common-source, PMOS current-source loads ----
XM6   voutp n1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=12
XM7   voutn n1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=12
XM8   voutp pb  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=700 nf=112
XM9   voutn pb  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=700 nf=112

* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistors ----
CCP  rcp n1p 1.4p
RZP  voutp rcp 450
CCN  rcn n1n 1.4p
RZN  voutn rcn 450

* ---- CMFB: low-gain diode-loaded diff pair senses (voutp+voutn)/2 vs vocm ----
* cm1 is INVERTING w.r.t. cso: cso up -> cm1 down -> M3/M4 conduct more ->
* n1p up -> M6/M7 conduct more -> output down (negative feedback).
RCSA   voutp cso 100k
CCSA   voutp cso 100f
CCSB   voutn cso 100f
RCSB   voutn cso 100k
XMC1T  c1t iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1000 nf=160
XMC1A  cm1 cso  c1t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XMC1B  d1b vocm c1t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XMC1P1 cm1 cm1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=315 nf=52
XMC1P2 d1b d1b  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=315 nf=52

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp, SKY130 1.8 V core devices.
* Stage 1: two mirrored LVT-PMOS-input five-transistor amplifiers.  Each
*          output common mode is set by an NMOS diode that carries the full
*          branch current, so no first-stage common-mode loop is needed.
* Stage 2: NMOS common-source pairs with PMOS current-source loads.
* Common-mode feedback: resistive output sensing into a resistor-loaded
*          differential amplifier driving the stage-2 load gates.  The
*          amplifier load resistor drop matches the stage-2 load Vgs so the
*          amplifier stays balanced at the commanded output common mode.
* Compensation: Miller capacitors with series nulling resistors.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias network (50 uA reference) ----------------
XBM   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=2 w=20  nf=4
XMPD  np   np   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.5 w=66  nf=4
XMN0  np   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=2 w=20  nf=4

* ---------------- stage 1A (vinp half) ----------------
XMTA  ntA np   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.5 w=324 nf=8
XMA1  pA  vinp ntA ntA sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=2 w=1010 nf=48
XMA2  dA  vinn ntA ntA sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=2 w=1010 nf=48
XMDA  dA  dA   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=2 w=96  nf=8
XMOA  pA  dA   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=2 w=96  nf=8

* ---------------- stage 1B (vinn half) ----------------
XMTB  ntB np   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.5 w=324 nf=8
XMB1  nB  vinn ntB ntB sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=2 w=1010 nf=48

XM6   voutn nB   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8    l=0.5 w=100 nf=8

XM8   voutn vc2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=1 w=138 nf=4

XMCF2 vc2  vocm ncf vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=2 w=8   nf=1
XMCT  ncf  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=2 w=4.1 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp, current biased, continuous-time
* transistor-level common-mode feedback.  SKY130 1.8 V core devices.
*
* Signal path:  NMOS diff pair (stage 1)  ->  NMOS common-source (stage 2)
* Stage-1 load: PMOS current source + NMOS bleeder diode that fixes the
*               stage-1 output common mode (referenced to vss).
* Stage-2 load: PMOS current source whose gate is driven by the CMFB amplifier.
* CMFB: resistive average of the two outputs, amplified against vocm.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ------------------------------ bias ---------------------------------
* iref sinks into an NMOS diode: v(iref) = VBN0, set by the 50 uA input
XMND0 iref  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=77  nf=2
* NMOS mirror of VBN0 into a PMOS diode: v(nb1) = VBP, the gate bias for the
* stage-1 PMOS loads
XMB1  nb1   iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=77  nf=2
XMPD  nb1   nb1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=100 nf=5
* --------------------------- stage 1 ---------------------------------
* tail current source, 200 uA
XMT   ntail iref  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=309 nf=10
* input pair, 100 uA each
XM1   nap   vinp  ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=160 nf=10
XM2   nan   vinn  ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=160 nf=10
* PMOS current-source loads, gates on VBP (112 uA each)
XM3   nap   nb1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=224 nf=8
XM4   nan   nb1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=224 nf=8
* NMOS bleeder diodes set the stage-1 output common mode
XMD1  nap   nap   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2.95 nf=1
XMD2  nan   nan   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2.95 nf=1

* --------------------------- stage 2 ---------------------------------
* NMOS common-source devices, 750 uA each
XM5   voutp nap   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=185 nf=4
XM6   voutn nan   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=185 nf=4
* PMOS current-source loads, gates driven by the CMFB amplifier
XM7   voutp ncm   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=485 nf=10
XM8   voutn ncm   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=485 nf=10

* ------------------------ miller compensation ------------------------
CC1   nap   voutp 3p
CC2   nan   voutn 3p

* --------------------- common-mode feedback sense --------------------
RS1   voutp ncs   100k
RS2   voutn ncs   100k

* ------------------------- CMFB amplifier ----------------------------
* NMOS diff pair, 3 uA per side
XMC1  nc1   ncs   ncmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=6.1 nf=1
XMC2  ncm   vocm  ncmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=6.1 nf=1
XMCT  ncmt  iref  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=9.3 nf=1
* PMOS mirror load
XMCP1 nc1   nc1   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=4.6 nf=1
XMCP2 ncm   nc1   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=4.6 nf=1
* CM loop compensation
CCC   ncm   vss   180p

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller CMOS op amp with continuous-time
* output common-mode control.  SKY130 transistor-level implementation.
*
* Topology:
*   - NMOS mirror bias chain referenced by the external iref (50 uA).
*   - Stage 1: NMOS differential pair (M1/M2) with NMOS tail current source,
*     PMOS current-source loads (M3/M4) whose gates form the first-stage
*     common-mode control node cmfb1.
*   - Stage 2: NMOS common-source pair (M5/M6) with PMOS current-source
*     loads (M7/M8) whose gates form the second-stage common-mode control
*     node cmfb2.
*   - Miller compensation Cc with a series nulling resistor Rz on each side.
*   - Common-mode feedback: two resistively-averaged sense networks and two
*     five-transistor CMFB amplifiers.  The first-stage CMFB references a
*     diode-connected replica of the second-stage input device (M5r) so that
*     n1/n2 settle at VGS(M5) and the stage-2 bias current tracks the
*     replica current over PVT.
*
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ------------------------- bias reference chain -------------------------
* Master diode-connected NMOS: absorbs the 50 uA delivered into iref and
* defines V(iref) as the gate reference for every NMOS current source.
XMb0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=5
* Stage-1 tail current source (200 uA -> 100 uA per input device).
XM0 tail1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=200 nf=20
* CMFB amplifier tail current sources (20 uA each).
XMc1 tca1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XMc2 tca2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=4
* NMOS mirror feeding the PMOS reference leg of the replica chain.
XMs pds iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=5
XMP0 pds pds vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=50 nf=5
* PMOS mirror output that biases the M5r replica at Id5/5.
XMP1 r1 pds vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=84 nf=8

* ------------- first-stage common-mode reference (replica) -------------
* Diode-connected replica of M5 at one fifth the width and current, so
* V(r1) equals VGS(M5) at the stage-2 bias current density.
XM5r r1 r1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=21 nf=2

* ----------------------------- first stage -----------------------------
XM1 n1 vinp tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=10
XM2 n2 vinn tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=10
XM3 n1 cmfb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=103 nf=10
XM4 n2 cmfb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=103 nf=10

* ----------------------------- second stage ----------------------------
XM5 voutp n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=105 nf=10
XM6 voutn n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=105 nf=10
XM7 voutp cmfb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=143 nf=10
XM8 voutn cmfb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=143 nf=10

* ------------------------ Miller compensation --------------------------
Cc1 n1 mz1 2.0p
Rz1 mz1 voutp 300
Cc2 n2 mz2 2.0p
Rz2 mz2 voutn 300

* ------------------- common-mode sense networks ------------------------
* Equal resistors from each output of a stage to its sense node give an
* exact average with no differential loading.
Rs1a n1 sc1 500k
Rs1b n2 sc1 500k
Rs2a voutp sc2 500k
Rs2b voutn sc2 500k

* --------------------- first-stage CMFB amplifier ----------------------
* Five-transistor OTA: low-VT NMOS input pair (headroom for the ~0.7 V
* stage-1 output CM), PMOS mirror load.  Output rises with the sensed
* average sc1, which reduces the stage-1 load currents and pulls n1/n2
* back down.
XMb1a c1x sc1 tca1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=1
XMb1b cmfb1 r1 tca1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=1
XMp1a c1x c1x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=1
XMp1b cmfb1 c1x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=1

* -------------------- second-stage CMFB amplifier ----------------------
* Same structure; output rises with the sensed output average sc2, which
* reduces the stage-2 load currents and pulls voutp/voutn back down.
XMb2a c2x sc2 tca2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=16 nf=2
XMb2b cmfb2 vocm tca2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=16 nf=2
XMp2a c2x c2x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=6.8 nf=2
XMp2b cmfb2 c2x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=6.8 nf=2

* --------------- common-mode loop compensation -------------------------
Ccm1 cmfb1 vss 40n
Ccm2 cmfb2 vss 5p

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with transistor-level CMFB.
* Pins: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* Two mirrored single-ended two-stage halves (non-inverting differential path).
* Stage 2 is PMOS CS + NMOS current source: stage-2 current falls as v1 rises,
* which self-limits fast-corner power. Output CMFB drives the NMOS sources.
* Miller Cc+Rz; Rz near 1/gm2 keeps the zero out of the band without
* letting an LHP zero extend UGB at fast corners.

.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---- bias: 50 uA into iref sets Vgs of the NMOS reference diode ----
XNREF  iref   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2

* ---- NMOS current sources (gate = iref) ----
XMP5   nsp    iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=48 nf=4
XMN5   nsn    iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=48 nf=4
XCTAIL ncmfb  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4  nf=2

* ---- P-half stage 1: NMOS pair + LVT PMOS current-mirror load ----
* diode side sees vinn, output side sees vinp  => non-inverting to voutp
XMP1   d1p    vinn nsp  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=240 nf=12
XMP2   v1p    vinp nsp  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=240 nf=12
XMP3   d1p    d1p  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.75 w=144 nf=8
XMP4   v1p    d1p  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.75 w=144 nf=8

* ---- N-half stage 1 ----
* diode side sees vinp, output side sees vinn  => non-inverting to -voutn
XMN1   d1n    vinp nsn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=240 nf=12
XMN2   v1n    vinn nsn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=240 nf=12
XMN3   d1n    d1n  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.75 w=144 nf=8
XMN4   v1n    d1n  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.75 w=144 nf=8

* ---- P-half stage 2: PMOS CS + NMOS source (CMFB) + Miller Cc/Rz ----
XMP6   voutp  v1p   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=255 nf=8
XMP8   voutp  vcmfb vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=50 nf=2
CCP    v1p    vzp   5.85p
RZP    vzp    voutp 285

* ---- N-half stage 2 ----
XMN6   voutn  v1n   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=255 nf=8
XMN8   voutn  vcmfb vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=50 nf=2
CCN    v1n    vzn   5.85p
RZN    vzn    voutn 285

* ---- output common-mode sense ----
RSP    voutp  vsense 200k
RSN    voutn  vsense 200k

* ---- CMFB amp: compare vsense to vocm, drive stage-2 NMOS sources ----
XC1    vcmfbd vsense ncmfb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XC2    vcmfb  vocm   ncmfb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XCP3   vcmfbd vcmfbd vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=12 nf=2
XCP4   vcmfb  vcmfbd vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=12 nf=2
CCM    vcmfb  vss  2.0p

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller-compensated CMOS operational amplifier.
* The only external bias is the 50-uA current delivered into iref.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* NMOS reference and mirrors.
XBNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=8 nf=2
XBTAIL tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=32 nf=8
XBCMT cmtail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=16 nf=4
XBSCT scmtail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=8 nf=2

* First differential stage.  The two drain nodes retain the full
* differential signal; identical current-source loads preserve symmetry.
XINP n1p vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=96 nf=24
XINN n1n vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=96 nf=24
XLP n1p p1cm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=32 nf=8
XLN n1n p1cm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=32 nf=8

* Local first-stage common-mode loop.  Two sensing devices sum the two
* first-stage voltages; two matched devices use the diode-biased iref node
* as a PVT-tracking internal common-mode reference.
XS1MP s1cma n1p scmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=16 nf=4
XS1MN s1cma n1n scmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=16 nf=4
XS1RP p1cm iref scmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=16 nf=4
XS1RN p1cm iref scmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=16 nf=4
XS1L0 s1cma s1cma vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=24 nf=6
XS1L1 p1cm s1cma vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=24 nf=6
R1CP p1cm c1cp 1.2k
C1CP c1cp n1p 1.5p
R1CN p1cm c1cn 1.2k
C1CN c1cn n1n 1.5p

* Inverting second stages.  Their PMOS load gates are driven together by
* the output-common-mode feedback amplifier below.
XONP voutp n1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=128 nf=32
XONN voutn n1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=128 nf=32
XOPP voutp pcm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=320 nf=80
XOPN voutn pcm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=320 nf=80

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp
* Continuous-time transistor-level output common-mode feedback.
* Public interface:
* .subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
*   vss  - negative supply (0 V)
*   iref - external bias current input (current sinked = IREF)
*   vdd  - positive supply rail
*   vinn - inverting input (common mode 0.9 V)
*   vinp - non-inverting input (common mode 0.9 V)
*   vocm - output common-mode command
*   voutn, voutp - differential outputs (each loads 1 pF to vss)
*
* Topology:
*   Stage 1: NMOS input differential pair with PMOS current-source loads
*            (CMFB1 sets stage-1 output common mode via internal reference).
*   Stage 2: cross-coupled NMOS common-source drivers with PMOS current-source
*            loads (CMFB2 sets output common mode to vocm).
*   Miller compensation: Cc+Rz from each stage-1 output to the inverting
*            second-stage drain (nulling resistor kills the RHP zero).
*   Both CMFB amplifiers use an NMOS diff pair + PMOS mirror.
*
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- Bias network ----------------
* Master NMOS diode: sinks iref (50 uA). Gate voltage = iref node is the
* NMOS mirror bias (bias_n). PMOS master produces bias_p.
XMN0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=10 nf=4
XMN00 bias_p iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=10 nf=4
XMP0  bias_p bias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=20 nf=4
* Stage-1 output common-mode reference (diode, 50 uA).
XMNREF ref1 ref1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=10 nf=4
XMPREF ref1 bias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=20 nf=4

* ---------------- Stage 1 ----------------
* Input differential pair (NMOS).
* a = drain of vinp-side device, b = drain of vinn-side device.
XMNT ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=40 nf=8
XMN1 a vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.9 w=72 nf=12
XMN2 b vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.9 w=72 nf=12
* Stage-1 loads (PMOS current sources) gated by CMFB1 node pcm1.
XMP3 a pcm1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=12 nf=4
XMP4 b pcm1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=12 nf=4

* ---------------- Stage 2 ----------------
* Cross-coupled common-source NMOS drivers:
*   voutp driven by stage-1 'a', voutn driven by stage-1 'b' (positive loop gain).
* Differential-pair tail current source fixes each driver's quiescent current
* so the output common mode is set by CMFB2 trim, robust across corners.
XMNST2 nst2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=210 nf=30
XMN5 voutp a nst2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=96 nf=16
XMN6 voutn b nst2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=96 nf=16
* Stage-2 PMOS current-source loads gated by CMFB2 node pcm.
XMP7 voutp pcm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=30 nf=6
XMP8 voutn pcm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=30 nf=6

* ---------------- Miller compensation (Cc + nulling Rz) ----------------
C1M a x1 1.2p
RZ1 x1 voutp 400
C2M b x2 1.2p
RZ2 x2 voutn 400

* ---------------- CMFB sensing ----------------
* Output common-mode sense.
RCMA voutp cms 10k
RCMB voutn cms 10k
* Stage-1 common-mode sense (large resistors to limit gain loading).
RCM1A a cms1 200k
RCM1B b cms1 200k

* ---------------- Output CMFB amplifier (drives pcm) ----------------
* Low-gain NMOS diff pair comparing cms (avg of vout) to vocm.
* PMOS diode mirror pulls pcm up when output CM is high.
* RCLAMP fixes the pcm-node output impedance; CCMF forces a dominant pole
* so the CMFB loop has a controlled ~5-10 MHz unity-gain frequency.
XCMA1 mrdo cms gcm2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=4 nf=2
XCMA2 pcm vocm gcm2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=4 nf=2
XCMA3 mrdo mrdo vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=8 nf=4
XCMA4 pcm mrdo vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=8 nf=4
XCMAT gcm2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=4 nf=2
CCMF pcm vss 15p

* ---------------- Stage-1 CMFB amplifier (drives pcm1) ----------------
* Compares cms1 (avg of a,b) to internal reference ref1.
XCMB1 mrd1 cms1 gcm1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=8 nf=4
XCMB2 pcm1 ref1 gcm1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=8 nf=4
XCMB3 mrd1 mrd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=16 nf=4
XCMB4 pcm1 mrd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=16 nf=4
XCMBT gcm1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=8 nf=2

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with transistor-level CMFB.
* Ports: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* External IREF forces 50uA into iref from vdd.
*
* Stage 1: two symmetric 5T OTAs with current-mirror loads.
*          High-Z (mirror) outputs, DC defined by resistors to iref.
*          Cross-coupled inputs give true differential stage-1 outputs.
* Stage 2: NMOS CS + PMOS current-source loads (gate = cmfb).
* CMFB:    resistive output-CM sense vs vocm, non-inverting 5T amp -> cmfb.
* Miller:  Cc + Rz from each stage-1 node to its stage-2 output.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias ----------------
* NMOS diode sinks the 50uA reference (W/L = 8 at L=0.5)
XND   iref  iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2

* NMOS current mirrors from iref
* 2x -> 100uA CMFB tail
XNT2  cmtail iref vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8  nf=4
* 4x -> 200uA per stage-1 tail
XNT3  tail1  iref vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XNT4  tail2  iref vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4

* ---------------- stage 1a (drives voutp path) ----------------
* Large-area input pair for low flicker noise.  W*L = 40 um^2.
XM1   d1a   vinn  tail1 vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=40 nf=8
XM2   v1p   vinp  tail1 vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=40 nf=8
* Current-mirror load.  L=1.0 for high Rout and lower gm3/gm1.
XM3   d1a   d1a   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=80 nf=8
XM4   v1p   d1a   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=80 nf=8
* DC definition of the high-Z node
RCM1  v1p   iref  30k

* ---------------- stage 1b (drives voutn path) ----------------
XM5   d1b   vinp  tail2 vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=40 nf=8
XM6   v1n   vinn  tail2 vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=40 nf=8
XM7   d1b   d1b   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=80 nf=8
XM8   v1n   d1b   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=80 nf=8
RCM2  v1n   iref  30k

* ---------------- stage 2 ----------------
* NMOS common-source, gates = stage-1 outputs.
XM9   voutp v1p   vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XM10  voutn v1n   vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
* PMOS current-source loads, gate = cmfb.
XM11  voutp cmfb  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XM12  voutn cmfb  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8

* ---------------- Miller compensation ----------------
CCP   v1p   vmidp 2.5p
RZP   vmidp voutp 800
CCN   v1n   vmidn 2.5p
RZN   vmidn voutn 800

* ---------------- output CM sense + CMFB ----------------
RSP   voutp vcms  200k
RSN   voutn vcms  200k
XD1   cmd   vcms  cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8  nf=4
XD2   cmfb  vocm  cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8  nf=4
XD3   cmd   cmd   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XD4   cmfb  cmd   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

* CMFB output dominant pole
CCM   cmfb  vss   0.5p

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with transistor-level CMFB.
* Stage 1: NMOS differential pair M1A/M1B with NMOS tail sink M5 and PMOS
* mirror load M3A/M3B.  Stage 2: PMOS common-source drivers M6P/M6N with
* NMOS CMFB-controlled current-source loads M7P/M7N.
* Miller compensation Cc + nulling resistor Rz per side.
* CMFB: resistive output common-mode sense (R1/R2), NMOS pair MCC1/MCC2 with
* PMOS mirror load MCC3/MCC4 drives the second-stage NMOS load gates; CCM
* gives Miller compensation of the common-mode loop.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* ---- bias generation from iref (50 uA) ----
XM0  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=1
XM4  nbp  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=1
XM2  nbp  nbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
* ---- stage 1: NMOS input pair, NMOS tail sink, PMOS mirror load ----
XM5  vtail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=240 nf=1
XM1A nA   vinp vtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=1
XM1B nB   vinn vtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=1
XM3A nA   nA   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=1
XM3B nB   nA   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=1
* ---- stage 2: PMOS common-source drivers ----
XM6P voutp nA vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=80 nf=1
XM6N voutn nB vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=80 nf=1
* ---- second-stage NMOS current-source loads (CMFB controlled) ----
XM7P voutp vcmfb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=196 nf=1
XM7N voutn vcmfb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=196 nf=1
* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistors ----
CCP  voutp nzp 2.7p
RZP  nzp   nA  260
CCN  voutn nzn 2.7p
RZN  nzn   nB  260
* ---- output common-mode feedback ----
R1   voutp vsense 4meg
R2   voutn vsense 4meg
CCM  vcmfb vsense 0.6p
XMCC5 nE   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=1
XMCC1 nC   vsense nE vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XMCC2 vcmfb vocm   nE vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XMCC3 nC   nC   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XMCC4 vcmfb nC   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with transistor-level CMFB.
* Pins: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* iref is the only external bias port (testbench sinks 50u into iref).
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias ----------------
* NMOS diode reference 50uA, large W/L so Vov is small (tail stays in sat)
XMB   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=12
* stage-1 tail 325uA (6.5x)
XMT1  nt1  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=312 nf=78
* PMOS reference diode via NMOS 50uA -> pb
XNPB  pb   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=6
XMPB  pb   pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=8
* CMFB pair tail
XMTC  tc   pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=96 nf=24

* ---------------- stage 1: NMOS pair + PMOS current-mirror load ----------------
* large-area pair for local-mismatch offset (keeps open-loop OP out of deep rail)
XM1   n1 vinn nt1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=192 nf=48
XM2   n2 vinp nt1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=192 nf=48
* LVT PMOS mirror: |Vth|~0.5 keeps n1 high enough for pair Vds at 1.62 V
XM3   n1 n1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=180 nf=45
XM4   n2 n1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=180 nf=45

* ---------------- stage 2: PMOS CS + NMOS current sources (CMFB) ----------------
* LVT PMOS shares Vsg with the stage-1 load
XM5   voutn n1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=456 nf=57
XM6   voutp n2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=456 nf=57
* LVT NMOS sinks stay in sat at low output when mismatched
XM7   voutn cmfb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=160 nf=40
XM8   voutp cmfb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=160 nf=40

* ---------------- Miller compensation ----------------
RZ1   n1  nc1 280
CC1   nc1 voutn 3.3p
RZ2   n2  nc2 280
CC2   nc2 voutp 3.3p

* ---------------- CMFB sense ----------------
RS1   voutp vcs 150k
RS2   voutn vcs 150k

* ---------------- CMFB amplifier (PMOS pair + NMOS mirror) ----------------
XM9   d9   vcs  tc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=3
XM10  cmfb vocm tc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=3
XM11  d9   d9   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=3
XM12  cmfb d9   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=3
RCM   cmfb ncx 10k
CCM   ncx vss 22p

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller-compensated CMOS op amp with
* continuous-time common-mode feedback.
*
* This PDK install has nshort Vth ~ 0.52 V and pshort |Vth| ~ 1.06 V, so
* signal-level gates (0.9 V) can only drive NMOS pairs.
*
* Topology
*   Bias  : external 50 uA (vdd -> iref) feeds a diode NMOS -> nbias.
*           An NMOS mirror pulls a diode PMOS branch -> pbias.
*   Stage1: NMOS input differential pair with NMOS tail, PMOS current-source
*           loads whose gate p1c is set by a stage-1 CMFB loop.
*   Stage2: NMOS common-source pair (gates held at the fixed nbias-referenced
*           stage-1 CM, so their current is rail invariant), PMOS current-
*           source loads whose gate n2c is set by the output CMFB.
*   Comp  : Miller RC (Cc + nulling Rz) on each differential path.
*   CMFB  : identical NMOS-pair / PMOS-mirror continuous-time amplifiers;
*           they sense the output average through matched positive
*           resistors and compare against vocm (stage 2) or nbias (stage 1).
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---- Bias network -------------------------------------------------------
* iref sinks the external 50 uA through the diode NMOS; node iref = nbias,
* Vov ~ 0.15 V.
XMNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=21 nf=3
* PMOS diode branch pulled by an NMOS mirror: pbias = vdd - Vsg, Vov ~0.2 V.
XMN0 pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=21 nf=3
XMPD   vdd pbias pbias vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=33 nf=3

* ---- First differential stage ------------------------------------------
* NMOS tail: 0.4 mA (8x reference).
XM5 tn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=168 nf=12
* NMOS input pair: 0.2 mA each, Vov ~ 0.15 V.
XM1 gp vinp tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=85 nf=5
XM2 gn vinn tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=85 nf=5
* PMOS current-source loads: gates driven by stage-1 CMFB (p1c).
XM3 gp p1c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=133 nf=7
XM4 gn p1c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=133 nf=7

* ---- Second (common-source) stage ---------------------------------------
* NMOS pair: gate CM is held at nbias (same Vgs as the 50 uA diode), so each
* carries ~10x = 0.5 mA independent of rail voltage; Vov ~ 0.15 V.
XM9  voutp gp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=212 nf=12
XM10 voutn gn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=212 nf=12
* PMOS current-source loads: gates driven by output CMFB (n2c), Vov ~0.2 V.
XM11 voutp n2c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=333 nf=17
XM12 voutn n2c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=333 nf=17

* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistor --------------------------
RZP gp   zcp 200
CCP zcp voutp 4p
RZN gn   zcn 200
CCN zcn voutn 4p

* ---- Common-mode sensing resistors --------------------------------------
* Output average for the output CMFB amplifier.
RSP1 voutp vseno 100k
RSN1 voutn vseno 100k
* Stage-1 output average for the stage-1 CMFB amplifier.
RSP2 gp vseng 100k
RSN2 gn vseng 100k

* ---- Continuous-time CMFB amplifiers ------------------------------------
* Output loop: sensed average vs vocm, drives PMOS load gates n2c.
XCMO vss iref pbias vdd vocm vseno n2c cmfb_amp
* Stage-1 loop: sensed average vs nbias (iref), drives PMOS load gates p1c.
XCMG vss iref pbias vdd iref vseng p1c cmfb_amp

* ---- CMFB loop compensation ---------------------------------------------
CCO n2c vss 2p
CCG p1c vss 2p
* Weak startup pulls: they break the all-off CMFB latch states and carry
* < 1.3 uA once the loops are alive (amp output easily overpowers them).
RCSO n2c vss 1meg
RCSG p1c vdd 1meg

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

* Continuous-time CMFB amplifier.
* NMOS source-coupled pair (50 uA tail) with PMOS current-mirror load.
* The sensed node drives the diode-connected mirror side (A); the reference
* drives the mirror-output side (B), vctrl = drain B.
* Polarity: vsen rising -> A current rises -> da falls -> mirror PMOS pulls B
* harder while B's NMOS current falls -> vctrl rises, weakening the PMOS
* devices whose gates it drives: negative feedback.
.subckt cmfb_amp vss nbias pbias vdd vref vsen vctrl
XMT  tailc nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=21 nf=3
XMA  da vsen tailc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10.5 nf=1
XMB  vctrl vref tailc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10.5 nf=1
XMPA vdd da da vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=17 nf=1
XMPB vdd vctrl da vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=17 nf=1
.ends cmfb_amp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
* Stage 1: LVT NMOS differential pair, PMOS current-source loads.
* Stage 2: NMOS common-source amplifiers with PMOS current-source loads,
*          whose gates are driven by the transistor-level CMFB amplifier.
* Compensation: Miller R/C per differential half; dual CM Miller caps.
* The external source pumps 50u INTO iref, so the reference device is a
* diode NMOS sinking to vss; pdiode is generated via a translator branch.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* ---- Bias references ----
* Diode NMOS carrying the external 50u; iref doubles as NMOS mirror gate.
XMNR   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
* 50u NMOS sink feeding a diode PMOS -> PMOS mirror gate pdiode.
XMXI   pdiode iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMPD   pdiode pdiode vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=6
* ---- First gain stage: LVT NMOS pair, PMOS loads ----
XMN1   n1p vinp vtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
XMN2   n1n vinn vtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
XMNT   vtail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
XMLP   n1p pdiode vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=12
XMLN   n1n pdiode vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=12
* ---- Second gain stage: NMOS CS + PMOS loads (gates = cmfb2) ----
XMN6P  voutp n1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XMN6N  voutn n1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XMP7P  voutp cmfb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=10
XMP7N  voutn cmfb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=10
* ---- Differential Miller compensation ----
RZP   n1p mzp 400
CCP   mzp voutp 2.2p
RZN   n1n mzn 400
CCN   mzn voutn 2.2p
* ---- Continuous-time common-mode feedback ----
* Resistive output common-mode sense (ideal matched resistors).
RSP   voutp vfb 100k
RSN   vfb voutn 100k
* LVT NMOS error pair: vfb on ME1, vocm on ME2; output cmfb2 at ME2 drain.
XME1   e1 vfb etail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XME2   cmfb2 vocm etail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMET   etail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XMEPL  e1 e1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=6
XMEPR  cmfb2 e1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=6
* CM-loop Miller compensation (dual caps cancel for differential signals).
CCPM  cmfb2 voutp 0.5p
CCNM  cmfb2 voutn 0.5p
.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp
