taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
* Pins: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* Topology:
*   - Stage 1: PMOS-lvt input differential pair, PMOS-lvt tail, NMOS
*     current-sink loads on a fixed replica gate bias (nbi).
*   - Stage 2: NMOS-lvt common-source pair (sources to vss), PMOS-lvt
*     current-source loads whose COMMON gate (cmfb) is set by the CMFB amp;
*     the loads move only in common, so the differential path still sees both
*     output resistances and is Miller RC compensated.
*   - One continuous-time CMFB amplifier: resistively senses the OUTPUT common
*     mode, compares it to vocm, and drives the stage-2 PMOS load gates. The
*     common-mode loop is a single gain stage (output node, 1 pF load) and is
*     therefore intrinsically stable; the compensation capacitor sets its
*     crossover frequency.
*   - All bias currents are mirrored from the external 50 uA iref port.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
*
* ---------------- Bias references ----------------
* NMOS diode on iref: 50 uA, sets n-type gate bias (node iref).
XMR0  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
* PMOS-lvt diode reference branch (node pbd), sunk by a 50 uA NMOS mirror.
XMNBR pbd  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XMPBR pbd  pbd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=25 nf=5
* Low-voltage n-type bias for the CMFB-amplifier tail (node nlx).
XMPBL nlx  pbd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5 nf=1
XMNL  nlx  nlx  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5 nf=1
* Replica bias for the stage-1 NMOS loads (node nbi): a diode carrying 25 uA
* at the same current density as each 125 uA stage-1 load (W ratio 5:1).
XMPNR nbi  pbd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=12.5 nf=2
XMNR  nbi  nbi  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=35 nf=5
*
* ---------------- Stage 1: PMOS-lvt differential pair ----------------
* Tail ~250 uA (5x the 50 uA pbd reference); 125 uA per input device.
XMP7  net1x pbd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=125 nf=25
XMP1  x1a  vinp net1x vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=125 nf=25
XMP2  x1b  vinn net1x vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=125 nf=25
* NMOS current-sink loads on the fixed replica bias nbi (125 uA each).
XMN1  x1a  nbi  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=175 nf=25
XMN2  x1b  nbi  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=175 nf=25
*
* ---------------- Stage 2: NMOS-lvt common-source, PMOS-lvt loads ----------
* NMOS-lvt input devices, sources to vss (no shared tail).
XMN3  voutp x1a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=190 nf=19
XMN4  voutn x1b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=190 nf=19
* PMOS-lvt loads; common gate cmfb is set by the CMFB amplifier.
XMP3  voutp cmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=190 nf=19
XMP4  voutn cmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=190 nf=19
* Miller compensation of the differential path with nulling resistors.
RZ1   x1a  c1   350
CC1   c1    voutp 1p
RZ2   x1b  c2   350
CC2   c2    voutn 1p
*
* ---------------- Output common-mode feedback amplifier -----------------
* Resistive sense of the output common mode (node vcmo).
RCM1  voutp vcmo 100k
RCM2  voutn vcmo 100k
CCMO  vcmo  vss  0.2p
* NMOS-lvt diff pair with PMOS-lvt mirror load.
* Diode-side XMC1 senses vcmo and output-side XMC2 references vocm, so a
* rising output common mode raises cmfb; the PMOS stage-2 loads then pull the
* outputs back down (negative feedback).
XMCT  cmct  nlx  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
XMC1  cmcd1 vcmo cmct vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMC2  cmfb  vocm cmct vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMPC1 cmcd1 cmcd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMPC2 cmfb  cmcd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=2
* Compensation of the CMFB-amplifier output node (PMOS load gates).
CCMFB cmfb  vdd  1p
.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller-compensated CMOS op amp.
*
* Pins: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* The external 50 uA reference feeds a diode NMOS (XMN0) on pin iref;
* all NMOS current mirrors hang off iref. A 50 uA mirror under a PMOS
* diode generates pbias, so both bias lines self-track their own rail.
*
* Signal path:
*   Stage 1: NMOS source-coupled pair XMN1/XMN2 (L=1, Vov ~0.18) with
*            PMOS current-source loads XMP3/XMP4 (Vov ~0.30).
*   Stage 2: NMOS common-source XMN6/XMN7 (Vov ~0.20) with PMOS loads
*            XMP8/XMP9.
*   Compensation: Rz + Cc Miller on each half (Cc = 0.65 pF).
* Two continuous-time CMFB loops:
*   Stage-1 CM: resistive average compared with vgref (the VGS of a
*               1/3 replica of XMN6); amp output drives tail XMN5 gate.
*   Output CM : resistive average compared to vocm by a five-transistor
*               amplifier whose output drives XMP8/XMP9 gates.

.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---- Reference input: 50 uA NMOS diode (Vov ~0.2) ----
XMN0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7.5 nf=2

* ---- pbias generator: 50 uA NMOS mirror under 50 uA PMOS diode ----
XMNPB pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7.5 nf=2
XMPBD pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2

* ---- Stage-1 input pair: tail gate driven by stage-1 CMFB amp ----
XMN5 vs cmfb1_g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=42 nf=10
XMN1 vop1 vinp vs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=29 nf=6
XMN2 von1 vinn vs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=29 nf=6

* ---- Stage-1 PMOS loads: 80 uA each, Vov ~0.30 (2x diode width) ----
XMP3 vop1 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12.8 nf=4

C1C cmfb1_g vss 1p

* ---- Stage 2: 300 uA per side, Vov ~0.20 ----
XMN6 voutp vop1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=44 nf=10
XMN7 voutn von1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=44 nf=10
XMP8 voutp cmfb_g vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=68 nf=16
XMP9 voutn cmfb_g vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=68 nf=16

* ---- Miller compensation: Rz slightly above 1/gm2 (~330) ----
RZPA voutp vrzp 450
CCPA vrzp vop1 0.65p
RZNA voutn vrzn 450
CCNA vrzn von1 0.65p

* ---- Output CM sense: resistive average ----
RSP voutp vcms 200k
RSN voutn vcms 200k

* ---- CMFB error amplifier (five-transistor OTA, 30 uA tail) ----
XMNCT scm iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.5 nf=2
* diode-side input is the sensed CM; this sets negative feedback polarity
XMNCA dca vcms scm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMNCB cmfb_g vocm scm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMPCA dca dca vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5.5 nf=2
XMPCB cmfb_g dca vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5.5 nf=2

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with output common-mode control.
* Interface: .subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* iref: external 50u bias current forced into node iref (used as NMOS gate bias reference).
* Transistor-level continuous-time CMFB for both the second-stage output common mode
* and the first-stage internal common mode. Ideal R/C allowed for sensing/compensation.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias: iref diode sets NMOS gate bias (vbiasn=iref); PMOS bias pbo via mirror.
* vref1 is a diode-referenced first-stage output common-mode target (~Vthn+0.25).
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
XMnbias iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMnpm   pbo  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMpbias pbo  pbo  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMr1cs  vref1 pbo vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMr1    vref1 vref1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.7 nf=1

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
* First stage: NMOS input pair M1/M2, NMOS tail M0 (gate=iref),
* PMOS current-source loads M3/M4 (gates driven by first-stage CMFB vcp1).
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
XM0 tailn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=2
XM1 na    vinp tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=56 nf=8
XM2 nb    vinn tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=56 nf=8
XM3 na    vcp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
XM4 nb    vcp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Second stage: common-source NMOS M7 (gates=na/nb) with PMOS current-source
* loads M8 (gates driven by output CMFB vcp2). na->voutp, nb->voutn.
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
XM7p voutp na vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=47 nf=8
XM7n voutn nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=47 nf=8
XM8p voutp vcp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=133 nf=20
XM8n voutn vcp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=133 nf=20

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Miller compensation (Cc) with nulling resistor Rz on each side.
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
CCp na   rp 1p
RZp rp   voutp 300
CCn nb   rn 1p
RZn rn   voutn 300

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Output common-mode feedback (CMFB2): resistive sense of (voutp+voutn)/2,
* compare to vocm, drive M8 gates (vcp2). 5T NMOS-input OTA, mirror side
* (Mc22=scm2) is non-inverting -> vcp2 rises with output CM -> reduces PMOS
* load current -> corrects CM downward.
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
Rop voutp scm2 1meg
Ron voutn scm2 1meg
XMc20 ct2  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=6 nf=2
XMc21 dc2a scm2 ct2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMc22 vcp2 vocm ct2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMc23 dc2a dc2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMc24 vcp2 dc2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
CC2 vcp2 vss 20p

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
* First-stage common-mode feedback (CMFB1): resistive sense of (na+nb)/2,
* compare to vref1, drive M3/M4 gates (vcp1). Same polarity as CMFB2.
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
R1a na sc1 1meg
R1b nb sc1 1meg
XMc10 ct1  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=6 nf=2
XMc11 dc1a sc1  ct1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMc12 vcp1 vref1 ct1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMc13 dc1a dc1a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMc14 vcp1 dc1a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
CC1 vcp1 vss 2p

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
* Interface: .subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* iref : external 50 uA bias (current forced into node iref; node iref = Vbn).
* vocm: desired output common-mode reference (~0.9 V), also the stage-1 CM target.
*
* Stage 1: NMOS input pair + PMOS current-source loads (gates = v1).
* Stage 2: NMOS common-source gain devices + PMOS current-source loads (gates=vc).
* Miller compensation per side with nulling resistor.
*
* Two INDEPENDENT continuous-time CMFB loops (gate-sensed, no output loading):
*  CMFB1 -> vc drives stage-2 PMOS loads. Senses OUTPUT CM (voutp,voutn).
*           fast 1-stage loop. out-CM high -> vc rises -> PMOS loads source less
*           -> out-CM falls.
*  CMFB2 -> v1 drives stage-1 PMOS loads. Senses STAGE-1 CM (s1p,s1n).
*           keeps M3/M6 in saturation (prevents the two-current-source CM
*           railing). s1-CM high -> v1 rises -> stage-1 PMOS loads source less
*           -> s1-CM falls.
* Two loops -> two controlled variables -> well-determined operating point.
*
* Geometry: l,w in um. nf integer, w/nf in [0.42,7] um.
* NMOS CS unit: l=4 w=28 nf=7 (W/L=4.0).  PMOS CS unit: l=4 w=135 nf=34.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

*---- Bias: external iref -> NMOS diode defines Vbn (node iref) ----
XMnbia iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=28 nf=7 m=1

*---- Stage 1: NMOS input diff pair + PMOS current-source loads (gate=v1) ----
XMt1   tn1  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=28 nf=7 m=12
XM1    s1p  vinp tn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=121 nf=30 m=1
XM2    s1n  vinn tn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=121 nf=30 m=1
XM3    s1p  v1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=135 nf=34 m=4
XM4    s1n  v1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=135 nf=34 m=4

*---- Stage 2: NMOS common-source + PMOS current-source loads (gate=vc) ----
XM6    voutp s1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22 nf=6 m=2

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
* Interface: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
*   iref  - external 50u bias current (forced INTO this node)
*   vocm  - output common-mode command (0.9 V)
* Topology:
*   Stage 1 : LVT NMOS input pair + PMOS current-source loads that are
*             replica biased at Iss1/2 (fixes the stage-1 operating point
*             without a local loop; wide tail keeps the current source
*             saturated across PVT).
*   Stage 2 : PMOS common-source pair + NMOS current-source loads, main
*             continuous-time CMFB holds voutp/voutn to vocm.
*   Miller compensation Cc + nulling resistor Rz around each stage-2 branch.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias: NMOS current mirror referenced to the external iref (50 uA).
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XMBn  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1

* Stage-1 tail Iss1 = 3*iref = 150 uA (wide device, low overdrive).
XMtail1  tail1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=160 nf=32
* Replica sink Iss1/2 = 75 uA for the stage-1 PMOS-load reference diode.
XMrep_p1 pbias1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=4
* Main CMFB error-amp tail (50 uA).
XMtc2 tcm2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage 1: LVT NMOS input pair, PMOS current-source loads (gate=pbias1).
* pbias1 is set by the replica diode XMpref carrying Iss1/2.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XM1p  s1p vinp tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=120 nf=24
XM1n  s1n vinn tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=120 nf=24

XM3p  s1p pbias1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=24
XM3n  s1n pbias1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=24

* Replica reference diode: PMOS identical to M3, biased at Iss1/2.
XMpref pbias1 pbias1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=24

* Miller compensation across stage 2 (Cc + nulling resistor Rz).
Rzp  voutp nzp 300
Ccp  nzp  s1p  1p
Rzn  voutn nzn 300
Ccn  nzn  s1n  1p

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage 2: PMOS common-source (gate=s1p/s1n) + NMOS loads (gate=cmfb2).
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XM5p  voutp s1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=24
XM5n  voutn s1n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=24

XM7p  voutp cmfb2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=24
XM7n  voutn cmfb2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=24

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Main output CMFB: holds avg(voutp,voutn) to vocm.
*   NMOS pair (Ma=sense, Mb=vocm) + PMOS mirror, output=cmfb2 -> M7/M8 gates.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
Rs2p voutp sen2 1meg
Rs2n voutn sen2 1meg

XMca2 a2    sen2  tcm2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMcb2 cmfb2 vocm  tcm2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMcp3 a2    a2    vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XMcp4 cmfb2 a2    vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
Cc2  cmfb2 vss 500f

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
*
* Stage 1: NMOS input pair (LVT-free 1.8V core devices, wide/low-Vov for
*          headroom against the 0.9 V input common mode) with CMFB-controlled
*          PMOS current-source loads.
* Stage 2: NMOS common-source pair with fixed-gate PMOS current-source loads.
* CMFB:   resistor-averaged output CM sense (with capacitive bypass), NMOS
*          error pair comparing the sense node with vocm, diode output that
*          both biases and modulates the stage-1 load gates.
* Compensation: Miller Cc with nulling resistor Rz per side.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- reference / bias ----------------
* iref receives 50 uA: NMOS diode sinks it and defines the NMOS gate bias
* (the iref node itself is the NMOS mirror reference, ~0.71 V).
XMND iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=46.6
* PMOS mirror branch: NMOS CS (gate=iref, 50 uA) pulls a PMOS diode down,
* defining vbiasp = vdd - |Vgs_p(50u)| for all PMOS current sources.
XPNB vbiasp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=46.6
XPDIB vbiasp vbiasp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10.1

* ---------------- first stage ----------------
* Input pair: 300 uA per side, low Vov for tail headroom.
XIN1 s1p vinp tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=226
XIN2 s1n vinn tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=226
* Tail: 600 uA, wide device so Vdsat stays below the worst-case tail node.
XIT tailn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=558
* Stage-1 loads (CMFB controlled): 300 uA per side.
XPL1 s1p vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=228.7
XPL2 s1n vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=228.7

* ---------------- second stage ----------------
* NMOS common-source output pair, 500 uA per side.
XO2P voutp s1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100
XO2N voutn s1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100
* PMOS current-source loads, 500 uA per side, mirrored from iref.
XO2LP voutp vbiasp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=100.8
XO2LN voutn vbiasp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=100.8

* ---------------- Miller compensation ----------------
CC1 s1p mz1 4p
RZ1 mz1 voutp 190
CC2 s1n mz2 4p
RZ2 mz2 voutn 190

* ---------------- output CM sense ----------------
RS1 voutp ncm 100k
RS2 voutn ncm 100k
CB1 voutp ncm 50f
CB2 voutn ncm 50f

* ---------------- CMFB error amplifier ----------------
* Error pair: vocm vs averaged output CM; single-ended output at vcmfb.
XE1 vdd vocm taile vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=76.5
XE2 vcmfb ncm taile vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=76.5
XTE taile iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=46.6
* Diode load / bias reference for the stage-1 load mirror (150 uA standing).
XEDB vcmfb vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=114.4
* Auxiliary sink (125 uA) sets the standing diode current.
XAUX vcmfb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=111.8

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage CMOS op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
* Architecture: NMOS-LVT input pair, PMOS-LVT first-stage load biased from
* the CMFB-controlled node vbp, NMOS common-source output drivers with
* PMOS-LVT current-source loads, Miller compensation with nulling resistors,
* and a dual cross-coupled diff-pair CMFB amplifier that senses both outputs
* against vocm and sums its correction current into the vbp diode node.
*
* The vbp branch uses a cascoded NMOS sink whose gate bias (the iref port
* node, a diode stack) is supply-independent, so the sink current does not
* scale with vdd; all NMOS mirrors are exact-geometry integer multiples of
* the reference diode so their ratios track across PVT.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---- reference: iref into LVT diode stacked on NMOS diode ----
* nmid (~0.66 V) gates every NMOS mirror; iref (~1.27 V) biases the cascode.
XMDL iref iref nmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=95 nf=95
XMR  nmid nmid vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=50

* ---- first stage: NMOS-LVT diff pair, PMOS-LVT load on CMFB node vbp ----
XM0  nt1 nmid vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=50 m=7
XM1P vo1p vinp nt1 vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=100 nf=50
XM1N vo1n vinn nt1 vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=100 nf=50
XM2P vo1p vbp vdd vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=77 nf=77
XM2N vo1n vbp vdd vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=77 nf=77

* ---- second stage: NMOS CS drivers, PMOS-LVT loads on fixed bias vbp2 ----

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller-compensated CMOS op amp with
* continuous-time CMFB.  SKY130, 1.8 V core devices.
*
* Topology: NMOS input pair (nfet_lvt, bulk at tail) + pfet_lvt loads whose
* gates are driven by CMFB node vpb1; second stage nfet drivers + pfet_lvt
* mirror loads.  CMFB: two nmos_lvt diff pairs (voutp/voutn vs vocm); the
* vout-sensing devices drain into the replica-diode node vpb1, closing the
* loop through the Miller path (so the CM loop shares the differential
* compensation: crossover ~= gm_sensor / (2 pi Cc)).  dnode is an identical
* dummy branch for the vocm-sensing devices.
*
* Bias: 50 uA into iref -> nfet diode MND0 (W=25 L=2 unit; all nfet mirror
* branches use the same unit geometry and L=2 so ratios are bin-consistent).
*
* Nodes: taile pair tail/bulk, oa/ob stg1 outputs, tsa/tsb sensor tails,
* vpb1 CMFB output, vpb2 stg2 pfet bias, dnode CMFB dummy drain, cz1/cz2 taps.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
*
* ---------- nfet current mirror (unit W=25 L=2, 50 uA) ----------
XMND0 iref  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=25 nf=1
XMT1  taile iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=198 nf=1
XMTSA tsa   iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=37.5 nf=1
XMTSB tsb   iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=37.5 nf=1
XMNU  vpb1  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=57 nf=1
XMNU2 dnode iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=57 nf=1
XMBL  vpb2  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=50 nf=1
* pfet mirror diode biasing the stage-2 loads
XMPD0 vpb2 vpb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=21 nf=1
*
* ---------- stage 1 ----------
XM1A oa vinp taile taile sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=200 nf=1
XM1B ob vinn taile taile sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=200 nf=1
XM3A oa vpb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=34.2 nf=1
XM3B ob vpb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=34.2 nf=1
*
* ---------- stage 2 ----------
XM2A voutp oa vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=39 nf=1
XM2B voutn ob vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=39 nf=1
XM4A voutp vpb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=104 nf=1
XM4B voutn vpb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=104 nf=1
*
* ---------- CMFB ----------
XMSA vpb1 voutp tsa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=25 nf=1
XMSB vpb1 voutn tsb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=25 nf=1
XMRA dnode vocm tsa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=25 nf=1
XMRB dnode vocm tsb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=25 nf=1
XMPD  vpb1  vpb1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=34.2 nf=1
XMPD2 dnode dnode vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=34.2 nf=1
*
* ---------- Miller compensation ----------
RZ1 voutp cz1 620
CC1 cz1 oa 1.8p
RZ2 voutn cz2 620
CC2 cz2 ob 1.8p
.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

* The testbench forces 50 uA from VDD into IREF.  This diode-connected
* reference transistor establishes the only internal analog bias reference.
XREFN   iref   iref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.50 w=2.0 nf=4
XBN     pbias  iref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.50 w=2.0 nf=4
XPREF   pbias  pbias  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.50 w=4.0 nf=4
XPCN    pcasb  iref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.50 w=2.0 nf=4
XPCREF  pcasb pcasb  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.50 w=4.0 nf=4

* Bias mirrors.  The input tail is 4x IREF; the CMFB tail is 1x IREF.
XTAIL   ntail  iref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.50 w=2.0 nf=4
XCTAIL  nctail iref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.50 w=2.0 nf=4
* Low-noise NMOS input pair and cascoded active load.
XCASBIAS ncas ncas vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=0.84 nf=2
XCaspb   ncas pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=8.0 nf=4
XINP     ndp vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.50 w=12.0 nf=6
XINN     ndn vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.50 w=12.0 nf=6
XCASP    n1p ncas ndp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=8.0 nf=4
XCASN    n1n ncas ndn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=8.0 nf=4
XPCP     pstackp pcasb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=12.0 nf=4
XPCN2    pstackn pcasb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=12.0 nf=4
XPLP     n1p pbias pstackp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=1.68 nf=4
XPLN     n1n pbias pstackn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=1.68 nf=4

* Second-stage common-source gain cells and PMOS current-source loads.
XGOP    voutp n1p  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=1.68 nf=4
XGON    voutn n1n  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=1.68 nf=4

RZN     n1n nzn 10k
CCP     nzp voutp 0.30p
CCN     nzn voutn 0.30p

* Fully differential, two-stage Miller-compensated OTA.
* The external 50 uA reference is mirrored locally; VOCM is used only by
* the continuous-time common-mode feedback amplifier.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* Reference and PMOS bias generator.
XMNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XMPB pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMNB pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1

* Differential input transconductor and high-impedance first-stage nodes.
XMTAIL ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=10
XMINP n1p vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=70 nf=10
XMINN n1n vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=70 nf=10

R1P n1p vss 82k
R1N n1n vss 82k

* First-stage common-mode servo prevents input CM motion from modulating the
* second differential pair.  Its low bandwidth leaves the differential path.
RC1P n1p c1m 100k
RC1N n1n c1m 100k
CC1S c1m vss 5f
XMC1T c1tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMC1P c1d c1m c1tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=18 nf=3

XMPC1O p1bias c1d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=14 nf=2
CC1FB p1bias vss 100n

* Current-biased differential second stage.  Its tail current, rather than
* the first-stage common-mode voltage, sets the output-stage dissipation.
XMN2T n2tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=160 nf=24
XMN2P voutp n1p n2tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=80 nf=12
XMN2N voutn n1n n2tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=80 nf=12
XMPLOADP voutp ncm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=80 nf=12
XMPLOADN voutn ncm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=80 nf=12

* Per-side Miller capacitors and nulling resistors preserve phase margin.
RZP n1p ccp 500
RZN n1n ccn 500
CCP ccp voutp 3.7p
CCN ccn voutn 3.7p

* Passive average of the two outputs.  The capacitor rolls off the sense
* node before the differential amplifier's high-frequency path.
RCMSP voutp cms 100k
RCMSN voutn cms 100k
CCMS cms vss 5f

* Continuous-time CMFB: cms above VOCM raises ncm and weakens both PMOS
* pull-ups.  The PMOS current mirror makes a single-ended control node.
XMCMT cm_tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMCMP cm_d cms cm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=18 nf=3
XMCMN ncm vocm cm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=18 nf=3
XMCPD cm_d cm_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=14 nf=2
XMCPO ncm cm_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=14 nf=2
* Dominant-pole compensation for the output common-mode loop.
CCMFB ncm vss 20p

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

circuit:
* Fully differential, two-stage Miller-compensated CMOS amplifier.
* External bias is a current sunk at iref.  All bias and CMFB functions
* below are continuous-time MOS circuits; the two capacitors are the
* differential Miller compensation elements.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* The external current biases a diode-connected NMOS.  Its gate node is
* reused directly by the current mirrors, so iref is a real analog bias.
XREF   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=8 nf=2
XNPREF pref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=8 nf=2
XPPREF pref pref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=16 nf=2

* First-stage tail current mirror and matched PMOS loads.
XTAIL  tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=16 nf=2
XINP   x_p  vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=80 nf=4 mult=16
XINN   x_n  vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=80 nf=4 mult=16
XPLP   x_p  pref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=20 nf=2
XPLN   x_n  pref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=20 nf=2


* Second-stage common-source devices and common-mode-controlled loads.
XOUTN  voutn x_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=16 nf=2
XOUTP  voutp x_p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=16 nf=2
XPL2N  voutn cmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=256 nf=4
XPL2P  voutp cmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=256 nf=4

* Resistive averaging senses only the output common mode.
RCMP   voutp vcm_s 200k
RCMN   voutn vcm_s 200k

* Continuous-time NMOS CMFB amplifier.  The output is taken from the
* vocm-gated branch so a high sensed output common mode raises cmfb and
* reduces the PMOS output pull-up current.
XCMT   cmfb vocm cmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=16 nf=2
XCMS   cmr vcm_s cmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=16 nf=2
XCMTL  cmt iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=16 nf=2
XCMLR  cmr cmr vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=32 nf=2
XCMLF  cmfb cmr vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=32 nf=2

* Differential Miller compensation with a small series zero resistor.
RZP    x_p mzp 1.7k
CZP    mzp voutp 1.2p
RZN    x_n mzn 1.7k
CZN    mzn voutn 1.2p

circuit:

* Ports: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* iref: 50 uA external reference current sunk to vss through a diode-connected LVT NMOS.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---- Bias generation ----
* iref node: LVT NMOS diode (Vov ~ 0.2 V); biases all LVT NMOS current sinks.
XMNREF  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 nf=4
* nbr: regular PMOS diode (Vov ~ 0.25 V); biases all PMOS current sources.
XMNREF2 nbr  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 nf=4
XMPREF  nbr  nbr  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=52.2 nf=9

XMPREF vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=12.00 nf=2

XMNBN  vbn vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=16.00 nf=4

* internal common-mode level without degrading the high-impedance gain node.

R1N vbn n1n 1meg

* Internal first-stage common-mode servo fixes the Miller input bias.
R1CMSP n1p v1cms 1meg
R1CMSN n1n v1cms 1meg

XM1CMR n1cmr vbn c1tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=12.00 nf=2
XM1CMPL n1cm n1cmr vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.70 w=6.00 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
* Ports: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* iref sinks 50 uA (external current source from vdd into iref).
*
* Architecture:
*   Stage 1: LVT NMOS input pair, PMOS current-source loads (fixed + CMFB-A trim).
*   Stage 2: NMOS common-source with PMOS loads (fixed + CMFB-B trim), Miller Cc+Rz.
*   CMFB-A: regulates first-stage common mode (n1/n2) against an NMOS-diode
*           replica of the second stage, so second-stage bias current is defined.
*   CMFB-B: regulates output common mode against vocm.
*   Servo:  slow differential clamp on n1/n2 keeps the open-loop operating
*           point centered under local mismatch (active only below ~0.1 Hz).
* Bias diodes are length-matched to their mirror loads.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---- Bias network -------------------------------------------------------
XB1  iref  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4  l=0.5 nf=2
XB2  pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=8  l=0.5 nf=2
XB3  pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=1.0 nf=4
* Replica of (M0/4 + M1/4 + M3A/4) generates pb4 so stage-1 load current
* tracks the tail current across corners.
XMR0 ntr  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=16.8 l=3.0 nf=2
XMR1 pb4  vocm ntr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=48 l=4.0 nf=2
XMR4 pb4  pb4  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=5.75 l=4.0 nf=1
XB5  pb2   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4  l=0.5 nf=2
XD2  pb2   pb2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=2.0 nf=2

* ---- Stage 1: input pair + loads ---------------------------------------
XM0  ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=115 l=3.0 nf=8
XM1  n1    vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=96 l=4.0 nf=8
XM2  n2    vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=96 l=4.0 nf=8
XM3A n1    pb4  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=23 l=4.0 nf=4
XM3B n1    cmfb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=1.0 nf=2
XM4A n2    pb4  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=23 l=4.0 nf=4
XM4B n2    cmfb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=1.0 nf=2

* ---- Stage 2: common-source + loads ------------------------------------
XM5  voutn n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=60 l=0.5 nf=12
XM6  voutp n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=60 l=0.5 nf=12
XM7A voutn pb2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=90 l=2.0 nf=8
XM7B voutn cmfb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=2.0 nf=8
XM8A voutp pb2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=90 l=2.0 nf=8
XM8B voutp cmfb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=2.0 nf=8

* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistors -------------------------
RZ1  n1 m1 250
CC1  m1 voutn 1.6p
RZ2  n2 m2 250
CC2  m2 voutp 1.6p

* ---- CMFB loop A: first-stage CM vs replica of second-stage device ------
R1A  n1 s1 400k
R1B  n2 s1 400k
XMR3 nrep pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=12 l=1.0 nf=2
XMR5 nrep nrep vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5 l=0.5 nf=1
XMA1 da1   s1   t1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.5 nf=2
XMB1 cmfb1 nrep t1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.5 nf=2
XMC1 da1   da1  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.35 nf=2
XMD1 cmfb1 da1  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.35 nf=2
XMT1 t1    pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=1.0 nf=2

* ---- CMFB loop B: output CM vs vocm -------------------------------------
R2A  voutp s2 100k
R2B  voutn s2 100k
XMA2 da2   s2   t2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=16 l=1.0 nf=4
XMB2 cmfb2 vocm t2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=16 l=1.0 nf=4
XMC2 da2   da2  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=16 l=2.0 nf=4
XMD2 cmfb2 da2  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=16 l=2.0 nf=4
XMT2 t2    pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=1.0 nf=2
CCM2 cmfb2 vdd 60p

* ---- Differential DC servo (keeps open-loop OP centered under mismatch) --
* Filtered differential clamp on n1/n2: the 1 uF cap between the sense nodes
* kills the servo's differential response above ~0.01 Hz while passing DC.
RSP1 n1 sp 10meg
RSN1 n2 sn 10meg
CSD  sp sn 1u
XSA  n1 sp  svv vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=40 l=2.0 nf=4
XSB  n2 sn  svv vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=40 l=2.0 nf=4
XST  svv iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2.0 l=0.5 nf=1
* ---- Output-sensing DC trim servo (nulls total offset incl. stage 2) ----
RSO1 voutp fp2 10meg
RSO2 voutn fn2 10meg
CSO  fp2 fn2 1u
XSOA n1 fp2 svo vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=10 l=1.0 nf=2
XSOB n2 fn2 svo vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=10 l=1.0 nf=2
XSTO svo iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=1.2 nf=1

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with transistor-level CMFB.
* Current-biased from IREF (50uA from VDD).
* First stage: NMOS LVT diff pair with PMOS current mirror loads (long channel for gain).
* Second stage: PMOS common-source with NMOS loads (CMFB-controlled).
* CMFB: NMOS diff pair comparing output CM to VOCM.
* Miller compensation: Cc from first-stage mirror output to second-stage output.

.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* === Bias Network ===
* M10: NMOS LVT diode, 50uA, sets VBN
XM10 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=67.2 nf=16
* M11: NMOS LVT mirror, 50uA into M12
XM11 nbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=67.2 nf=16
* M12: PMOS diode, 50uA, sets VBP
XM12 nbp nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=33.6 nf=8

* === First Stage: Diff Pair with PMOS Current Mirror Load ===
* Tail: 4x M10 = 200uA total (two devices, each 2x M10)
XM5a tail1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=67.2 nf=16
XM5b tail1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=67.2 nf=16
* M1, M2: NMOS LVT input, 100uA each (2x M10 W/L)
XM1 n1 vinp tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=67.2 nf=16
XM2 n2 vinn tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=67.2 nf=16
* M3: PMOS diode-connected load, l=4 for high ro, 2x M12 current
XM3 n1 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=33.6 nf=8
* M4: PMOS mirror (same as M3), 100uA
XM4 n2 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=33.6 nf=8

* === Second Stage: PMOS CS with NMOS Loads ===
* M6: PMOS CS, gate=n2, 200uA (4x M12 W/L), l=2 for gain
XM6 voutp n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=67.2 nf=16
* M7: PMOS CS, gate=n1, 100uA (2x M12 W/L)
XM7 voutn n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=33.6 nf=8
* M8, M9: NMOS loads, controlled by CMFB
XM8 voutp vcmfb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=134.4 nf=32
XM9 voutn vcmfb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=134.4 nf=32

* === Miller Compensation ===
Cc n2 voutp 2p

* === CMFB: resistive sense + active amplifier ===
* Resistive sense divider
R1 voutp vcm_sense 10k
R2 voutn vcm_sense 10k
* CMFB error amplifier: NMOS diff pair with PMOS diode/mirror load
XM13 vcmfb vocm tail_cmfb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=33.6 nf=8
XM14 cmfb_mid vcm_sense tail_cmfb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=33.6 nf=8
XM15 cmfb_mid cmfb_mid vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16.8 nf=4
XM16 vcmfb cmfb_mid vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16.8 nf=4
* CMFB tail: 2x M10 = 100uA
XM17a tail_cmfb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=67.2 nf=16
XM17b tail_cmfb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=67.2 nf=16

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with CMFB.
*
* Architecture:
*   Self-biased tail: Rstart (1.5k, vss to tail1) sets tail current.
*   Stage 1: NMOS diff pair + PMOS current mirror load (single-ended n2).
*   Stage 2: NMOS diff pair (n2 vs vocm) + PMOS loads (CMFB driven via bias_p).
*             Creates fully differential outputs.
*   CMFB: Rcm sense + NMOS diff pair + PMOS mirror → bias_p.
*   Bias: M14 NMOS diode at iref for CMFB tail.
*   Miller compensation from stage 1 output to stage 2 outputs.

.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* === Tail bias (self-biased via Rstart) ===
Rstart tail1 vss 1.5k

* === Stage 1: NMOS diff pair + PMOS current mirror load ===
XM1 n1 vinp tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4
XM2 n2 vinn tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4
XM3 n1 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=2
XM4 n2 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=2

* === Stage 2: NMOS diff pair (differential) + PMOS loads ===
* n2 drives M9, vocm drives M10. Creates fully differential output.
XM9  voutn n2   tail2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4
XM10 voutp vocm tail2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4
XM11 voutn bias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XM12 voutp bias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2

* === Stage 2 tail (NMOS, gate=iref) ===
XM17 tail2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20

* === Bias ===
XM14 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2

* === Miller compensation from n2 to outputs ===
Cc1 n2 voutn 2p
Cc2 n2 voutp 2p

* === CMFB sensing ===
Rcm1 voutn cms 10k
Rcm2 voutp cms 10k

* === CMFB amplifier ===
XM18 cmfb_tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4
XM20 cmfb_n1 cms  cmfb_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2
XM21 cmfb_n2 vocm cmfb_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2
XM24 cmfb_n1 cmfb_n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XM25 cmfb_n2 cmfb_n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2

* === CMFB -> Stage 2 PMOS loads (via common-gate level shift) ===
R30 bias_p vss 10k
XM31 bias_p cmfb_n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* NMOS-input fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with transistor CMFB
* Architecture: NMOS diff pair (LVT) + PMOS loads → PMOS CS + NMOS loads (CMFB)
* Bias: NMOS ref diode sets nbias; separate PMOS bias branch sets pbias

.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* === Bias Network ===
* NMOS reference diode: small W/L to get high nbias for tail headroom
* W/L=5, l=2, w=5, nf=5 → w/nf=1.0 (min for nfet)
XBN_REF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=5
* PMOS bias branch: NMOS sink mirrors ref current into PMOS diode
XBN_SINK pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=5
XBP_BIAS pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=5

* === Stage 1: NMOS LVT Diff Pair + PMOS Current Mirror Loads ===
* NMOS tail current source (target 500u, large W/L for low Vov)
XM_TAIL ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=60
* NMOS LVT diff pair (LVT for low Vtn, good gm)
XM1 n1 vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=20
XM2 n2 vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=20
* PMOS loads (gate=pbias, current set by mirror ratio to bias diode)
* Ratio: (W/L=100) / (W/L=10) = 10x → each load carries 10×I_ref
XM3 n1 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=50
XM4 n2 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=50

* === Stage 2: PMOS CS + NMOS Loads ===
* PMOS common-source amps (driven by stage 1 outputs)
XM5 voutn n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=40
XM6 voutp n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=40
* NMOS loads (CMFB-controlled gate bias)
XM7 voutn ncmfb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=40
XM8 voutp ncmfb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=40

* === Miller Compensation with Nulling Resistors ===
RZ1 n1 n_cc1 300
CC1 n_cc1 voutn 3p
RZ2 n2 n_cc2 300
CC2 n_cc2 voutp 3p

* === Common-Mode Feedback ===
* Resistive CM sensing
RCM1 voutp vcm_sense 100k
RCM2 voutn vcm_sense 100k
* CMFB differential pair: compare sensed CM to VOCM
XM_C1 ncmfb vocm cmfb_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=10
XM_C2 ncmfb_mirror vcm_sense cmfb_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=10
* CMFB PMOS mirror load
XM_C3 ncmfb_mirror ncmfb_mirror vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=4
XM_C4 ncmfb ncmfb_mirror vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=4
* CMFB tail current source
XM_CTAIL cmfb_tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=5
* CMFB compensation cap
CCFB ncmfb vss 20p

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Current-biased fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with output CMFB.
* Ports: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------- Bias reference ----------
* iref (50 uA) flows through MREF to set Vrefn; all NMOS mirrors copy it.
XMREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=1

* ---------- Tail current sources (CMFB-controlled via node vgcm) ----------
XT1 tail1 vgcm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=644 nf=2
XT2 tail2 vgcm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=644 nf=2

* Error-amplifier tail: PMOS device biased from the output load-bias node.
XTE etail vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=1

* ---------- PMOS load bias for the output stage ----------
XMV vbp2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=352 nf=1
XMPV vbp2 vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=1

* ---------- Input differential pair + PMOS current-mirror load (stage 1) ----------
XM1 na vinp tail1 tail1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=322 nf=2
XM2 nb vinn tail1 tail1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=322 nf=2
XM3 na na vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=1
XM4 nb na vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=1

* ---------- Output stage: NMOS pair + fixed-gate PMOS loads (stage 2) ----------
XM6 voutn na tail2 tail2 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=322 nf=2
XM7 voutp nb tail2 tail2 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=322 nf=2
XM9 voutp vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=1
XM10 voutn vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=1

* ---------- Miller compensation (same-side, inverting nodes) ----------
RN1 voutp rn1n 680
CC1 rn1n nb 2.2p
RN2 voutn rn2n 680
CC2 rn2n na 2.2p

* ---------- Output common-mode sensing ----------
RS1 voutp sens 300k
RS2 voutn sens 300k

* ---------- CMFB error amplifier ----------
XE1 e1 sens etail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=1
XE2 ve vocm etail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=1
XE3 e1 e1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XE4 ve e1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1

* ---------- CMFB correction network ----------
RTIE iref vgcm 2k
RCMFB ve vgcm 1k

RCM1 voutp vss 100k
RCM2 voutn vss 100k
.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller op amp with output common-mode feedback
* Bias: iref (50 uA) sets Viref; mirrored to all bias currents
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
*--- Reference: diode NMOS sets Viref at 50 uA ---
XMNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
*--- NMOS -> PMOS domain crossing for stage-2 load bias Vbp ---
XMNCOPY vbnp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMPREF vbnp vbnp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
*--- Stage-2 PMOS current-source loads ---
XMLOADP voutp vbnp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=1
XMLOADN voutn vbnp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=1
*--- Stage 1: NMOS diff pair + PMOS mirror load ---
XM1 xp vinp vtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=1
XM2 xn vinn vtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=1
* CMFB-controlled tail (vctl = error-amp output e1)
XMTAIL vtail e1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=1
XM3 xp xp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=1
XM4 xn xp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=1
*--- Stage 2: NMOS common-source with PMOS current-source loads ---
XM6 voutp xp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=1
XM7 voutn xn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=1
*--- CMFB error amplifier: NMOS input pair, PMOS diode load, out=e1 -> vctl ---
XME1 e1 s etp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=1
XME2 e2 vocm etp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=1
XME3 e1 e1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=1
XMETP etp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=1
*--- Output common-mode sensing ---
RS1 voutp s 100k
RS2 voutn s 100k
*--- Miller compensation with nulling resistors ---
RX1 xp nrc1 300
CC1 nrc1 voutp 0.3p
RX2 xn nrc2 300
CC2 nrc2 voutn 0.3p
.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller-compensated op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
* Designed for the high-Vth devices in this PDK install (Vthn ~ 0.58, |Vthp| ~ 0.78),
* so both input pairs are NMOS; 0.9 V input CM leaves no headroom for a PMOS pair.
*
* Stage 1: two NMOS differential pairs sharing one tail current source.
*   pair A (drains a_p/a_n, PMOS current-source loads biased from pnode) drives the
*   second-stage NMOS gates.
*   pair C (drains c_p/c_n, diode-connected PMOS loads) drives the second-stage PMOS
*   gates; the stage-2 PMOS devices are mirrors of those diode loads, so their current
*   tracks pair C's branch current across corners.
* Stage 2: complementary push-pull (a_p drives the voutp NMOS, c_p the voutp PMOS).
* Compensation: Miller caps with series nulling resistors from each output to its a and
* c nodes.
* CMFB: 2k resistive output CM sense -> continuous-time CM amp (vs vocm) -> PMOS trim
* devices sourcing correction current into the a nodes, which servo the output CM.
* Bias: all currents mirrored from the 50 uA iref sink.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias generation ----------------
* NMOS master diode at the iref pin (50 uA, Vov ~ 0.2).
XMB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.6 nf=2
* PMOS master reference from vdd, forced by an NMOS mirror of iref.
XPR1 pnode pnode vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMSP pnode iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.6 nf=2
* Low-Vgs NMOS diode (50 uA) lifted by RNB so nb2 also covers the source elevation of
* the tail/CM-amp mirrors: nb2 ~ Vgs_diode + 50u*3.9k ~ 0.89 V.
XPB nb2 pnode vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
RNB nb2 nbd 4.4k
XNB2 nbd nbd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12.9 nf=4

* ---------------- first stage ----------------
* Shared tail (200 uA).
XTAIL sn nb2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32.9 nf=8
* Pair A: 50 uA/side, moderate inversion.
XM1AP a_p vinp sn sn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10.9 nf=4
XM1AN a_n vinn sn sn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10.9 nf=4
* Pair C: 50 uA/side.
XM1CP c_p vinp sn sn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10.9 nf=4
XM1CN c_n vinn sn sn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10.9 nf=4
* Pair A PMOS loads (~12% deliberately low so the CM trim always sources positive
* correction current; the CM loop then trims the a nodes to balance stage 2).
XMLPA a_p pnode vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14.1 nf=4
XMLNA a_n pnode vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14.1 nf=4
* Pair C diode-connected PMOS loads; mirrored into the stage-2 PMOS devices.
XDLCP c_p c_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22.2 nf=8
XDLCN c_n c_n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22.2 nf=8

* ---------------- second stage ----------------
XM2NP voutp a_p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=8
XM2NN voutn a_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=8
XM2PP voutp c_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=93.3 nf=24
XM2PN voutn c_n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=93.3 nf=24

* ---------------- Miller compensation ----------------
RZAP voutp nzap 470
CCAP nzap a_p 1.5p
RZCP voutp nzcp 470
CCCP nzcp c_p 1.2p
RZAN voutn nzan 470
CCAN nzan a_n 1.5p
RZCN voutn nzcn 470
CCCN nzcn c_n 1.2p

* ---------------- CMFB ----------------
RSNSP voutp scm 2k
RSNSN voutn scm 2k
XCMT scmt nb2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.6 nf=2
XCM1 dcm1 vocm scmt scmt sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.95 nf=2
XCM2 dcm2 scm scmt scmt sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.95 nf=2
RCM1 dcm1 vdd 27k
RCM2 dcm2 vdd 27k
* Trim PMOS devices sourcing CM correction current into the a nodes.
XTRP a_p dcm2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.4 nf=1
XTRN a_n dcm2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.4 nf=1

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller-compensated op amp, continuous-time CMFB.
* Stage 1: LVT NMOS pair, PMOS mirror load, long-L NMOS tail.
* Stage 2: NMOS common-source drivers (gates = stage-1 outputs),
*          PMOS current-source loads biased from pb2.
* CMFB: 20k resistive output averaging into an NMOS-pair / PMOS-mirror error
*       amplifier that steers the tail-current gate (tailbias).
* All biasing derived from the external iref (50 uA) pin.
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias: iref sinks 50 uA into an NMOS diode -> iref node = Vbn.
* pb2 = vdd - |Vgs_p(50 uA)| gates the second-stage PMOS loads.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
CBN   iref vss 1p
XN1   pb2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14 nf=2
XPB2  pb2 pb2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=46.5 nf=7
CBP   pb2 vss 1p

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* First stage: LVT NMOS pair, PMOS mirror load, long-L NMOS tail.
* Tail gate = tailbias from the CMFB amplifier (~400 uA).
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XM1 na vinp t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=500 nf=80
XM2 nb vinn t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=500 nf=80
XM3 na na  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=123.5 nf=18
XM4 nb na  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=123.5 nf=18
XMTAIL t1 tailbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=543 nf=78

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Second stage: NMOS drivers, PMOS loads (gates = pb2).
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XM5 voutp na vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=219 nf=32
XM6 voutn nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=219 nf=32
XM7 voutp pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=467 nf=67
XM8 voutn pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=467 nf=67

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Differential gain-setting load (no DC current, symmetric).
RLOAD voutp voutn 5.6k

* Miller compensation (same-side caps with nulling resistors).
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
RZ1 voutp nz1 200
CC1 nz1 na 3.6p
RZ2 voutn nz2 200
CC2 nz2 nb 3.6p

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Continuous-time CMFB.
* outputs up -> cs up -> MC2 sinks more -> tailbias down -> tail
* current down -> na up -> drivers sink more -> outputs down.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
RS1 voutp cs 20k
RS2 voutn cs 20k
XMCT tcm iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28 nf=4
XMC1 c2  vocm tcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=15.5 nf=3
XMC2 tailbias cs tcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=15.5 nf=3
XMC3 c2  c2   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=6
XMC4 tailbias c2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=6
CCB tailbias vss 0.5p

.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Current-Biased Fully Differential Two-Stage Op Amp: Gain 60 dB, UGB 100 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller-compensated CMOS op amp with continuous-time CMFB.
* Topology:
*  - Stage 1: symmetric OTA. Two NMOS differential pairs (M1A/M1B tail MT1, M2A/M2B
*    tail MT2). The drain current of M1A is mirrored by PMOS mirror PA3/PA4 into node
*    vob; the drain current of M1B is mirrored by PMOS mirror PB3/PB4 into node voa.
*    M2B drains directly into voa, M2A directly into vob. With vid = vinp - vinn,
*    voa is the inverting and vob the non-inverting first-stage output. Small PMOS
*    current-source loads MLA/MLB provide a surplus sourcing current which the CMFB
*    trim devices MNC1/MNC2 absorb, giving the trim loop bidirectional authority.
*  - Stage 2: NMOS common-source pair M5 (gate voa) / M6 (gate vob) with PMOS
*    current-source loads M7/M8 (fixed bias pbias2). Overall differential gain is
*    positive (voa inverting -> M5 inverts -> voutp non-inverting).
*  - Miller compensation CZ1/RZ1 (voa->voutp) and CZ2/RZ2 (vob->voutn).
*  - RFA/RFB (large) pin the differential DC level of the first-stage outputs
*    through the second stage.
*  - CMFB: divider RS1/RS2 senses the output common mode at vcm_s; NMOS-pair CM error
*    amplifier (MC9/MC10, PMOS mirror load MC11/MC12) drives trim devices MNC1/MNC2
*    which sink balancing current from the first-stage output nodes. The CM loop is
*    compensated by the same Miller capacitors.
*  - Bias: master diode MN0 on iref (50 uA); all bias currents are mirrored from it.
*  - RST1/RST2 pull the mirror diode nodes low at power-up so PA3/PB3 bootstrap the
*    normal operating point (prevents the all-devices-off equilibrium).
.subckt fd_two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* --- Bias generator chain -------------------------------------------------
XMN0   iref   iref   vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=1   w=5   nf=1
* First-stage surplus-load bias branch (60 uA): sets pbias1.
XMPD0  pbias1 pbias1 vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=1   w=30  nf=6
XMNB1  pbias1 iref   vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=1   w=6   nf=2
* Second-stage PMOS load bias branch (400 uA): sets pbias2.
XMPD1  pbias2 pbias2 vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=1   w=180 nf=30
XMNB2  pbias2 iref   vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=1   w=50  nf=10
* --- Stage 1: symmetric OTA -----------------------------------------------
* Pair 1: M1A gate=vinp, M1B gate=vinn; drain currents mirrored by PA3/PA4, PB3/PB4.
XM1A   ma_g   vinp   st1   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=1   w=96  nf=12
XM1B   mb_g   vinn   st1   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=1   w=96  nf=12
XMT1   st1    iref   vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=1   w=36  nf=6
XMPA3  ma_g   ma_g   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=1   w=24  nf=6
XMPA4  vob    ma_g   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=1   w=24  nf=6
* Pair 2: M2A gate=vinn drains into vob, M2B gate=vinp drains into voa.
XM2A   vob    vinn   st2   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=1   w=96  nf=12
XM2B   voa    vinp   st2   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=1   w=96  nf=12
XMT2   st2    iref   vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=1   w=36  nf=6
XMPB3  mb_g   mb_g   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=1   w=24  nf=6
XMPB4  voa    mb_g   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=1   w=24  nf=6
* Small PMOS surplus loads (10 uA each) give the CMFB trim a quiescent current.
XMLA   voa    pbias1 vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=1   w=5   nf=1
XMLB   vob    pbias1 vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=1   w=5   nf=1
* --- Stage 2: NMOS common-source pair with PMOS current-source loads ------
XM5    voutp  voa    vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=0.5 w=320 nf=64
XM6    voutn  vob    vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=0.5 w=320 nf=64
XM7    voutp  pbias2 vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=1   w=180 nf=30
XM8    voutn  pbias2 vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=1   w=180 nf=30
* Startup bleeds: hold mirror diode nodes low until PA3/PB3 bootstrap.
RST1  ma_g   vss    2meg
RST2  mb_g   vss    2meg
* DC pinning of the first-stage differential mode through the second stage.
RFA   voa    voutp  1meg
RFB   vob    voutn  1meg
* Differential dead-zone clamp: when the differential output exceeds roughly
* one Vth (only possible in open loop, e.g. mismatch OP), these devices pull
* the first-stage outputs back so the second stage stays in its linear region.
* Off for all closed-loop signal swings (|vod| <= 0.4 V + margin).
XCL1  vob    voutp  voutn  vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=1   w=6   nf=2
XCL2  voa    voutn  voutp  vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=1   w=6   nf=2
* --- Miller compensation with nulling resistors ----------------------------
CZ1   voa    nz1    2.7p
RZ1   nz1    voutp  200
CZ2   vob    nz2    2.7p
RZ2   nz2    voutn  200
* --- CMFB trim devices at the first-stage output nodes ---------------------
XMNC1  voa    vcmfb  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=1   w=0.6 nf=1
XMNC2  vob    vcmfb  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=1   w=0.6 nf=1
* --- CMFB sensing divider ---------------------------------------------------
RS1   voutp  vcm_s  33k
RS2   voutn  vcm_s  33k
CSNS  vcm_s  vss    25f
* --- CMFB error amplifier (NMOS pair, PMOS mirror load) ---------------------
* MC9 gate = sensed CM, MC10 gate = vocm reference.
XMTCM  cmtl   iref   vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=1   w=3   nf=3
XMC9   vcmfb  vcm_s  cmtl  vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=0.5 w=10  nf=2
XMC10  cmg1   vocm   cmtl  vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=0.5 w=10  nf=2
XMC11  cmg1   cmg1   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=0.5 w=17  nf=4
XMC12  vcmfb  cmg1   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=0.5 w=17  nf=4
.ends fd_two_stage_miller_opamp
